title: Executive Assistant - Consultancy - Zaventem
description:
As an Executive Assistant, you provide high-level administrative support to senior executives, ensuring smooth coordination of agendas, meetings, travel arrangements, and confidential communication. You play a key role in maintaining efficient operations in a fast-paced and professional international environment.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established large organization in the professional services sector. They have a strong reputation for delivering high-quality services to a global client base and are known for fostering an environment of professionalism and excellence.

Description

As an Executive Assistant your responsibilities are:

  • Managing and organizing calendars, appointments, and meetings for senior executives.
  • Coordinating travel arrangements, including booking flights, accommodations, and transportation.
  • Preparing and editing correspondence, reports, and presentations.
  • Acting as a point of contact between executives and internal/external stakeholders.
  • Handling confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Organizing and maintaining files, records, and documentation.
  • Assisting with event planning and coordination for internal and external meetings.
  • Providing general administrative support to the secretarial and business support department.

A successful Executive Assistant should have:

  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills with an eye for detail.
  • Proficiency in office software and tools, including Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Experience in managing schedules and coordinating travel arrangements.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus.
  • Ability to handle sensitive information with confidentiality and professionalism.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and flexibility in a fast-paced environment.
  • Knowledge of the professional services industry is an advantage.

title: Logistics Administrator
description:
The Logistics Administrator will play a vital role in ensuring the smooth and efficient coordination of logistics activities within the Pharma sector. This temporary role is based in Wavre and requires a detail-oriented professional with a strong organizational mindset.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established medium-sized player in the pharma sector. They are committed to delivering high-quality products and maintaining an efficient logistics operation to meet client demands.

Description

As a Logistics Administrator your responsibilities are:

  • Coordinate inbound and outbound shipments, ensuring timely delivery and accuracy of documentation.
  • Maintain and update inventory records to ensure stock levels align with operational requirements.
  • Communicate with suppliers and transport providers to resolve any logistical issues.
  • Prepare and process shipping documents, such as invoices and packing lists.
  • Monitor and track shipments to ensure on-time delivery to customers.
  • Support the logistics team with administrative tasks and data entry as required.
  • Ensure compliance with safety and regulatory requirements within the logistics department.
  • Provide regular reports on logistics activities and performance metrics to management.

A successful Logistics Administrator should have:

  • An educational background in logistics, supply chain, or a related field.
  • Previous experience in logistics or administrative roles within the industrial/manufacturing sector.
  • Proficiency in logistics software and tools, with an eye for detail and accuracy.
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills to handle complex logistical challenges.
  • Excellent communication skills to liaise effectively with internal teams and external partners.
  • A proactive attitude with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

title: Payroll Officer - Zaventem
description:
In this role, you will be a key partner within the HR organisation, taking ownership of the complete payroll cycle for Belgium and Luxembourg. You combine strong attention to detail with a customer-oriented mindset and actively contribute to improving HR processes.

Client Details

Our client is an international organisation contributing to innovation and sustainable solutions within the industrial sector. To strengthen their HR team, they are looking for a Payroll Officer who will ensure a smooth, accurate and high-quality payroll experience for employees and managers.

Description

As a Payroll Officer, you will be responsible for a broad range of payroll and HR administration activities:

  • Managing the end-to-end payroll process for the Belux region, including onboarding, offboarding and employee changes.
  • Maintaining and validating payroll data, time registrations, leave balances and absences.
  • Preparing payroll payments, performing monthly controls and supporting reconciliations, year-end closing and audits.
  • Ensuring accurate and timely processing of social security and legal payroll documentation.
  • Preparing payroll reports and acting as a point of contact for employees, managers and internal stakeholders.
  • Supporting payroll-related financial reporting processes.
  • Contributing to payroll improvement initiatives and HR projects.
  • Managing group and health insurance administration, including monthly follow-up and annual evaluations.
  • Handling administrative processes such as A1 certificates, American Express requests and meal and eco vouchers.
  • Reviewing and approving invoices according to internal control procedures.
  • Collaborating closely with external payroll providers, authorities and suppliers while continuously improving processes and documentation.
  • You hold a bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Accounting & Taxation or a related field.
  • You have several years of payroll experience, preferably within an international environment.
  • You have a strong understanding of Belgian social and tax legislation.
  • You are proficient in MS Office, especially Excel. Experience with SAP HR, Workday or other payroll systems is a plus.
  • You are analytical, detail-oriented and committed to delivering high-quality work.
  • You have a strong service mindset and enjoy working with different stakeholders.
  • You are fluent in Dutch, French and English, both written and spoken.

title: Senior Business Analyst / Project Manager IT
description:
Our client is a leading international player operating in the retail and distribution sector, with a strong presence in multiple markets. The company provides a wide range of products and services to both professional and private customers, supported by an extensive network and a strong focus on customer experience.

As part of the IT organization, you will play a key role in analyzing, optimizing, and transforming business processes across Supply Chain and Finance domains. Acting as a strategic business partner, you will work closely with business stakeholders to understand operational challenges, identify improvement opportunities, and translate business needs into sustainable IT solutions.


Jobomschrijving

  • Analyze end-to-end business processes, particularly within Supply Chain and Finance, and identify opportunities for optimization and efficiency gains.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand challenges, define requirements, and design improved processes.
  • Translate business needs into pragmatic, scalable, and sustainable SAP-based solutions.
  • Challenge business requirements by proposing alternatives aligned with industry best practices and standard solutions.
  • Lead or contribute to functional design activities, testing phases, implementation projects, and change initiatives.
  • Coordinate collaboration between business teams, IT teams, SAP experts, and external partners to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Ensure consistency and integration across SAP modules and business processes.
  • Support issue resolution by providing functional expertise and a strong understanding of business impacts.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to the evolution of the application landscape.

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in a Senior Business Analyst, SAP Consultant, SAP Functional Analyst, or similar role.
  • Proven experience working on SAP-related projects, with strong knowledge of Supply Chain and/or Finance processes.
  • Good understanding of end-to-end business processes, ideally within a retail, distribution, or complex operational environment.
  • Ability to quickly understand business challenges and translate them into effective solutions.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to structure complex topics and provide clear recommendations.
  • Experience managing projects, coordinating stakeholders, and driving delivery is a strong asset.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact confidently with both business and technical audiences.

  • Proactive, autonomous, and comfortable working in a dynamic and evolving environment.
  • Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French is considered an advantage.
  • Open-minded, collaborative, and motivated by change and continuous improvement.

's Morgens komen de monteurs samen in Sint-Truiden en vertrekken ze naar de verschillende werven, de techniekers vertrekken rechtstreeks van thuis met een camionette.

description:
bpost is the number one postal operator and the main universal service provider in Belgium.


Jobomschrijving

Are you passionate about transport and do you always prioritize safety? Then get behind the wheel at bpost as a truckdriver!
You will drive according to a fixed route schedule to the various sorting centers, the post offices or possibly to our customers.
You are responsible for loading and unloading the truck.
Besides these tasks and responsibilities, you and your colleagues will ensure that everything runs smoothly in the transport warehouse and on the quays.

- At all times, you respect the traffic rules and the bpost safety guidelines.
- In addition, you have a sporty disposition and can also do some physically demanding work.
- Working different shifts does not put you off.
- You can produce a certificate of good behavior and morals.
- You are at least 18 years old and have at least completed primary education.
- You have a CE driving license.

title: Verzorgende Dienst gezins- en bejaardenhulp - Home Care (Antwerpse districten)
description:
Als Verzorgende binnen onze dienst gezins- en bejaardenhulp ondersteun je bejaarden, personen met een handicap en zorgbehoevenden in hun thuisomgeving. Dankzij jouw inzet kunnen zij zo lang mogelijk zelfstandig en comfortabel thuis blijven wonen.

Je dagelijkse bezigheden binnen onze dienst gezins- en bejaardenhulp bestaan uit:

  • Het helpen bij de huishoudelijke taken van bejaarden, mensen met een handicap en zorgbehoevenden thuis;

Voor deze functie van Verzorgende verwachten wij van jou:

  • Het bezit van een wagen.

title: Nachtverpleegkundige - WZC Seniorplaza
description:
Als nachtverpleegkundige bij Seniorplaza krijg je de ruimte om jouw expertise in te zetten binnen een multidisciplinair team. Je volgt bewoners op, denkt mee en bouwt een sterke zorgrelatie op. Je bent een baken van rust in de nacht en blinkt uit in het bewaren van de rust. Je zorgt voor de verbinding tussen nacht en dag en brieft je collega's zodat deze aan een vlotte werkshift kunnen beginnen.

Je dagelijkse bezigheden bestaan uit:

  • je voert verpleegkundige handelingen uit volgens de geldende richtlijnen;
  • je coördineert en bewaakt het zorgplan van bewoners;
  • je observeert en rapporteert veranderingen in gezondheidstoestand;
  • je ondersteunt en begeleidt zorgkundigen;
  • je bereid de werking van de volgende dagshift voor;
  • je voert administratieve taken uit in functie van kwalitatieve zorg.

Als nachtverpleegkundige draag je bij aan verpleegkundige handelingen, zorgplanning, opvolging van zorgtrajecten en begeleiding van zorgkundigen. Samen met je collega’s zorg jij voor persoonsgerichte, kwalitatieve zorg met een sterke band met bewoners en familie. Daarnaast staan de kwaliteiten klinisch inzicht, communicatie en verantwoordelijkheid centraal. Die heb je nodig omdat je coördineert, observeert, beslissingen onderbouwt en als aanspreekpunt fungeert.

Verder vragen wij:

  • professionele bachelor verpleegkunde of HBO5 + visum;
  • ervaring: niet vereist (wel een plus);
  • sterk in zorgplan opvolgen, rapporteren en samenwerken multidisciplinair;
  • goede kennis Nederlands;
  • flexibel, stressbestendig en een hoog verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel.

title: Zorgkundige - WZC Seniorplaza
description:
Bij Seniorplaza draag je als zorgkundige bij aan een huiselijke sfeer en zorg op maat. Je bent een vertrouwd gezicht voor bewoners en maakt het verschil in kleine momenten van aandacht. Je werkt nauw samen met verpleegkundigen en collega’s om kwaliteitsvolle, persoonsgerichte zorg te bieden.

Jouw dagelijkse bezigheden bestaan uit:

  • je voert gedelegeerde verzorgende en verpleegkundige handelingen uit;

  • je biedt comfortzorg en preventieve zorg;
  • je observeert en rapporteert veranderingen;
  • je ondersteunt bij maaltijden, medicatie en dagelijkse activiteiten;
  • je draagt bij aan orde en netheid op de afdeling.

Als zorgkundige draag je bij aan dagelijkse verzorging, hygiëne, comfortzorg en preventieve zorg, met aandacht voor orde en netheid op de afdeling. Samen met je collega’s zorg jij voor een huiselijke sfeer en zorg op maat, elke dag opnieuw. Daarnaast staan de kwaliteiten betrokkenheid, nauwkeurigheid en teamgerichtheid centraal. title: HVAC-monteur
description:
Onze klant gelegen in Sint-Truiden is gespecialiseerd in HVAC-montage en technieken. Ze zijn niet een doorsnee chauffagist, maar staan voor duurzaamheid en innovatie. 's Morgens komen de monteurs samen in Sint-Truiden en vertrekken ze naar de verschillende werven, de techniekers vertrekken rechtstreeks van thuis met een camionette.
De werven zijn gelegen in Limburg, Vlaams-Brabant en Antwerpen. Ze werken zowel bij particuliere als op grote projecten. Als de werf of moet bundelen ze de krachten, maar kan het zijn dat je een overuur maakt. Over het algemeen is dit niet veel en werk je 8 uur per dag op de werf. Het bedrijf geeft graag kansen aan mensen zo zijn er dus ook doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen het bedrijf. Je komt hier terecht in een bedrijf met aangename sfeer.


Jobomschrijving

Voor de job als HVAC-monteur voor de regio van Sint-Truiden ben je verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Installeren van verwarming, sanitair en ventilatie
  • Gecombineerd met volgende technieken: zonneboilers, airco's, warmtepompen & zonneboilers (in mindere mate)
  • Focus op Samsung & Vaillant toestellen
  • Werven voor projectbouw (meerdere woningen of appartementen) of winkelbouw (provider winkels, zowel nieuwbouw als renovatie)

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

Voor de job als HVAC-monteur voor de regio van Sint-Truiden is het ideale profiel:

  • Je bent bereid te werken op werven over gans België
  • Kan werken zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband
  • Toont verantwoordelijkheidszin naar de eindklant
  • Komt terecht in een groeiende onderneming met een jong doch ervaren team
  • Hebt interesse in de wereld van de HVAC en diens continu evoluerende technieken

title: Regioverantwoordelijke Provincie Antwerpen flex / huisbezoeker
description:
Als regioverantwoordelijke flex zorg je mee voor de continuïteit van de werking binnen thuiszorg in de provincie Antwerpen. Je springt in waar het druk is of waar een collega tijdelijk afwezig is, en je ondersteunt teams vanuit ons kantoor in Willebroek. Je combineert organisatie en people management met een mensgerichte aanpak: je motiveert medewerkers, bewaakt planningen en onderhoudt contacten met cliënten en doorverwijzers. Dankzij jouw overzicht blijft de dienstverlening betrouwbaar en goed afgestemd op de klant.

Jouw dagelijkse taken zijn:

  • je zorgt mee voor de continuïteit van onze werking gezinszorg/poetsdienst waar een collega tijdelijk afwezig is of waar het extra druk is;
  • je maakt planningen op en volgt verlof, bezetting en inzetbaarheid op voor een team van 30-35 medewerkers;
  • je voert huisbezoeken uit en bewaakt de kwaliteit en afstemming van de dienstverlening;
  • je voert gesprekken met medewerkers rond functioneren, welbevinden en ontwikkeling;
  • je motiveert, enthousiasmeert en stuurt bij waar nodig, met aandacht voor teamdynamiek;
  • je speelt in op noden en wensen van cliënten vanuit het volledige aanbod van Korian Home Care;
  • je onderhoudt contacten met medewerkers, cliënten en doorverwijzers;
  • je volgt opleiding en inwerktrajecten vanuit de kantoren in Willebroek.

Als regioverantwoordelijke flex draag je bij aan de continuïteit van de gezinszorg of poetsdienst binnen jouw regio. Je maakt planningen op, ondersteunt medewerkers, voert huisbezoeken uit en bewaakt de kwaliteit van dienstverlening. Je motiveert teams en onderhoudt contacten met cliënten en doorverwijzers. Samen met je collega’s zorg jij voor een betrouwbare en mensgerichte dienstverlening. Daarnaast staan de kwaliteiten organisatorisch sterk, communicatief en mensgericht binnen jouw functie centraal. Die heb je nodig omdat je teams aanstuurt en dienstverlening op elkaar afstemt.

Verder vragen wij:

  • je beschikt over minimaal een bachelor diploma (bij voorkeur zorg gerelateerd);
  • je kan zelfstandig werken en initiatief nemen;
  • je bent flexibel en betrokken;
  • je kan zeer goed plannen en denkt oplossingsgericht;
  • je beschikt over een rijbewijs en eigen wagen;
  • je kan vlot communiceren in het Nederlands (mondeling en schriftelijk).

title: Poetshulp - regio Mechelen
description:
Als poetshulp in regio Mechelen ondersteun je cliënten die door gezondheidsredenen het huishouden niet meer volledig zelf kunnen doen. Jij helpt hen om in een nette, veilige en aangename thuisomgeving te blijven wonen. Je werkt zelfstandig bij mensen thuis en zorgt met jouw hulp voor comfort, rust en meer levenskwaliteit in het dagelijks leven. Jouw nieuwe taken:

  • je maakt de woning schoon (stofzuigen, dweilen, afstoffen en algemeen onderhoud);
  • je reinigt keuken en sanitair en zorgt voor hygiëne en orde;
  • je maakt bedden op en ververst lakens volgens afspraak;
  • je helpt bij opruimen en het ordelijk houden van leefruimtes;
  • je verlucht kamers en draagt bij aan een frisse woonomgeving;
  • je doet afwas en bergt de vaat op indien dit binnen het takenpakket valt;
  • je werkt discreet en respectvol, met aandacht voor de gewoontes van de cliënt.

Als poetshulp in regio Mechelen draag je bij aan comfort en zelfstandigheid van cliënten in hun eigen woning. Je helpt met huishoudelijke taken zodat mensen veilig en aangenaam thuis kunnen blijven wonen. Samen met je cliënten zorg jij voor netheid, rust en een verzorgde thuisomgeving. Daarnaast staan de kwaliteiten zelfstandig, betrouwbaar en sociaal voelend binnen jouw functie centraal. Die heb je nodig omdat je alleen werkt bij mensen thuis en je rekening houdt met hun gewoontes en privacy. Verder vragen wij:

  • geen specifieke studievereisten;
  • je kan zelfstandig werken en neemt initiatief;
  • je bent flexibel en sociaal ingesteld;
  • je bent in het bezit van een wagen;
  • goede kennis van het Nederlands.

title: maatwerkcoach - teamleider - monitor
description:
De maatwerkcoach is de eerste leidinggevende van een toegewezen groep maatwerkers. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de aansturing van het team en de coördinatie van het productieproces. Het coachen en begeleiden van maatwerkers is dus een essentieel onderdeel, met het oog op hun duurzame inzetbaarheid, veiligheid, welzijn en groei.

Je hebt zin om erin te vliegen, je bent organisatorisch sterk en vooral je hebt veel empathie zodat je je medewerkers begrijpt en er in slaagt het beste uit zichzelf naar boven te halen.

title: 🏠Persoonsbegeleider N.A.H.
description:
Ben je op zoek naar een job met zin(geving)?

Ben jij die zorgzame woonbegeleider (voltijds of 4/5 ) die zorg wil dragen voor volwassenen met een Niet Aangeboren Hersenletsel met al dan niet bijkomende fysieke en/of psychische zorgvragen.

  • Je staat dagelijks in voor de zorg van het Algemeen Dagelijks Leven,(ADL) zoals je thuis zou doen, maar dan aangepast aan de zorgvraag van de bewoners, gaande van begeleiden bij ontbijt-tot en met de avondsituatie , dit binnen shiften van 7u30 /8.00 per dag. Je werkt binnen een variabel uurrooster tussen 07:00-21:00 , wat maandelijks wordt vastgeklikt.
  • Naast de lichamelijke zorgvragen, bied je kortdurende activiteiten aan , aangepast aan de vraag van de bewoners ( wandeling, krant voorlezen, gezelschapsspel, creatief aan de slag gaan ...) . Je volgt hierin het tempo van de bewoner en straalt rust uit.
  • Je werkt samen met 2 andere collega's op de dienst en wordt logistiek ondersteund door onderhoudsdienst en thuiszorgdiensten. Vanaf 20:45 start de actieve nachtdienst voor de nachtondersteuning die overneemt. Er staat dus 1 medewerker per verdiep: op de eerste verdieping wonen 8 personen met een meer fysieke beperking, op de bovenverdieping wonen 14 bewoners met die iets mobieler zijn en een 8-tal personen die wat meer zelfredzaam zijn.
  • Je werkt 1 WE /2 ( zaterdag en zondag) en je ontvangt hiervoor bijzondere prestaties ( +20% op zaterdagen, +50% op feestdagen , +100% op zondagen).
  • Na een inwerkperiode van een aantal maanden, sta je via de opmaak en opvolging van het pedagogisch handelingsplan in voor de pedagogische opvolging van een aantal bewoners die je intensiever opvolgt naar te realiseren doelstellingen.
  • Naast de opvolging van het pedagogisch handelingsplan, verricht je minimale administratieve opvolging via het intern communicatieplatform (observatie, maaltijdbestellingen, ...)

Zoek je een job met zingeving binnen het landelijke Lennik waarbinnen jij het verschil kan maken? Solliciteer dan snel voor dit vervangingscontract . Het contract loopt af wanneer de medewerker terugkomt uit ziekte.

Wil jij eens proeven van deze werking? solliciteer dan snel!

Ben jij flexibel? ben je sterk in communicatie?

Kan je zelfstandig werken, maar ben je ook sterk in samenwerken, dan ben jij met een hart en met een diploma in de zorg , de geknipte kandidaat.

title: Network Security Engineer (M/F/X)
description:
Vinçotte is the market leader in Belgium and offers objective and advisory services in inspection, certification, conformity assessment and training. Our team of over 1,500 professionals is committed to a safer and more efficient society. Our sector specialists understand the needs of customers perfectly and guide them along the way with advice and support. Aiming for results for multinationals, SMEs, self-employed persons and private persons is what makes our blood flow. We are looking for a Network Security Engineer (M/F/X) to join our team in Vilvoorde.

Ready to level up your career and secure the digital world? As a Network Security Engineer (M/F/X) you’ll be the go-to expert managing our network and security infrastructure – across our campus, datacenter, and Microsoft Azure environment.

What will you do?

  • Take charge of our network & security landscape, both on-prem and in the cloud (Azure).
  • Provide Level 2 support for complex IT network issues.
  • Dive into IT projects related to your area of expertise.
  • Work autonomously in an agile setup with a clear backlog and strategic focus.
  • Help improve documentation and technical guidelines.
  • Detect, assess, and fix security risks – you're our digital guardian.
  • Manage and fine-tune spam filters to keep our communications safe.

Experience:

  • You've already rolled up your sleeves in network and firewall management — think design, setup, config, upgrades — and you know your way around operational environments.
  • You’re certified in Azure, have experience with it, or you're eager to dive in and grow into a true Azure pro.
  • You’re ready to become our in-house expert on Microsoft Security tools — managing, fine-tuning, and pushing them to keep cyber threats out.
  • You're curious about Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and see it as a powerful tool in building fast, scalable, modern environments.
  • You believe solid processes are the backbone of great IT — and you embrace ITIL best practices to keep things running smoothly and smartly.
  • You hold an IT bachelor degree and have 2-3 years of relevant experience in the following domains:
    • Routing & Switching: Aruba and / or Cisco
    • Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) : Fortinet, Check Point or Palo Alto
    • Reverse Proxy : BlueCoat, Fortiweb or Azure Application GW
    • SASE/SDWAN: CATO, Fortinet, zScaler or Pallo Alto
    • Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) CATO and / or zScaler
    • Cloud Networking & Security: Azure 
    • Network Access Control (802.1X Wired/Wireless, RADIUS, TACACS, Guest Portals)
    • Vulnerability management: Nessus, MS Defender or Qualys
    • Network Detection and Response (NDR): Darktrace 
    • Extended Detection and Response (XDR): MS Defender and / or Sentinelone, 
    • Spam filtering: MS Defender, Barracuda or Cisco Ironport 


Personality:

  • You don’t wait around — when something’s blocking the business, you jump in and fix it fast.
  • You’re all about progress: positive mindset, always learning, always improving, and staying sharp on the latest tech trends.
  • Agile is your jam — you thrive in sprints, love a good retro, and believe great things happen when teams grow together.

 

Languages:

  • Dutch or French? Check. English? No problem — you’re fluent in the language of international teamwork.

title: Temporary Administrative Support Officer – PhD & Internship Recruitment
description:
Are you an organized, proactive, and customer-focused administrator with a passion for supporting recruitment processes?

We are looking for an Administrative Support Officer to support the recruitment of PhD candidates and interns within an innovative, international environment.

  • Manage and publish PhD research topics on online job platforms.
  • Screen applications for completeness and coordinate the recruitment process.
  • Follow up with stakeholders during screening and interview stages and provide interview guidelines.
  • Keep candidates informed throughout the recruitment journey.
  • Prepare job offers and support onboarding activities.
  • Coordinate internship opportunities, publish vacancies, and answer student inquiries.

Your profile

  • Degree in Office Management or equivalent experience in an administrative role.
  • Proactive, accurate, stress-resistant, and service-oriented.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills.
  • Proficient in Office 365 (Outlook, OneNote, SharePoint).
  • Fluent in English

title: Orderpicker – Night Shift | Earn €20.85 per hour! – Become an essential link at SKF
description:
Are you ready to work night shifts and do you already have some experience as an order picker? Then this is your chance!

SKF, specialized in bearings, seals and lubrication systems, is the place where you contribute to keeping the world running smoothly daily. We are looking for motivated warehouse workers who provide top-quality service to our customers.

What will you do?
? Collect and prepare orders like a true professional
? Work with a high order-picking truck (no fear of heights!)
? Grow step by step thanks to internal training


Your work schedule:
Fixed night shift: Monday evening 22:00 – Saturday morning 06:00 Full-time or part-time. For part-time: Minimum 3 days per week. Option: 5 half days.

?? A high school diploma and initial experience as an orderpicker
?? No fear of heights and good physical condition

title: Hotel Manager (General Manager/in (Hotellerie))
description:
Hotel Manager

Job Description

Your responsibilities will also include the following:

- As Hotel Manager, you will represent The Cloud One Hotels brand by delivering the unique "Let's Celebrate Life Experience" to our guests and team.
- In your role, you will be responsible for selecting, leading and supporting the team throughout the opening, with a main focus on training and development.
- Together with colleagues of the Motel One Group, you will be involved in the conception and organisation of events and activations, F&B concepts and the development of relationships with local creatives, businesses and partnerships.
- You will be responsible for organising, coordinating and controlling all operational and administrative departments as well as ensuring and implementing service standards.
- You will be responsible for achieving the turnover targets and adhering to the cost budget as well as carrying out weekly, monthly and annual financial statements.

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Qualifications

- Qualifications
- You have a degree in hospitality or a similar field and have already gained at least 5 years experience in a similar position. Ideally, you also have experience in the field of events and F&B.
- You have proven leadership experience and the ability to motivate and develop your team.
- You are well acquainted with the hospitality industry in Brussels and have experience in lifestyle and large-scale hotel operations.
- You know the trends, local scene locations and styles in your city and are cosmopolitan and open-minded at the same time.
- You have a passion for hospitality and practise it together with your team in direct guest contact.
- You are familiar with both strategic and everyday details. You bring entrepreneurial thinking, organisational skills, assertiveness in combination with a strong commercial mindset to the table.
- You have a very open and communicative manner bringing in a wide network and easy to connect with the local Brussels scene.

title: Medewerker Front Office (Portier (Gaststätte, Hotel))
description:
Medewerker Front Office

Vacatureomschrijving

In deze functie bent u onze hotelgasten professioneel van dienst – dit begint bij een warm welkom tijdens het inchecken en eindigt met een oprecht afscheid bij het vertrek. Tevens behoren de volgende werkzaamheden tot uw takenpakket:

- Onze gasten van dienst zijn, incl. in- en uitchecken
- Boekingen, overboekingen en opties beoordelen en verwerken
- Facturatie, inclusief betalingen beheren, evenals contante betalingen en afrekenen
- Organisatorische en administratieve taken, zowel voor onze front- als backoffice (bijv. no-shows afwikkelen, e-mails beantwoorden)
- Interdepartementale inzichten verkrijgen in nieuwe werkgebieden door in onze multiculturele teams te werken

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Functie-eisen

Voor deze functie zoeken wij een kandidaat met een eerste relevante ervaring binnen de hotellerie of hospitalitysector.

Daarnaast beschikt u over:

- Ervaring aan een hotelreceptie of in een vergelijkbare gastgerichte functie
- Ervaring met één of meerdere Property Management Systems (PMS); kennis van Opera Cloud is een pluspunt
- Een uitstekende servicegerichtheid en oog voor detail
- Goede organisatorische en administratieve vaardigheden
- Een professionele en zelfstandige werkhouding
- Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels; kennis van andere talen is een plus
- Flexibiliteit om in wisselende diensten, inclusief weekends en feestdagen, te werken
- Een echte teamspirit en de bereidheid om collega's te ondersteunen waar nodig

title: Operations Coordinator - Dutch & German speaking m/f/d (Callcenteragent/in)
description:
**Location:**  Ghent

Client confidential

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future? If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

This is us, your new colleagues

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.

This is the job

- Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind.
- Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress.
- A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box.
- Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business

Are you the one?

- You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers.
- You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported.
- You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset.
- You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up.
- You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills.
- You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients.
- You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German.

A perfect match? Just some of the benefits working for us...

- Competitive salary, with meal vouchers, transport costs, shift allowance, etc.
- Well-being services
- Restaurant on site
- Opportunity to grow within the company
- Good work life balance
- International environment
- Support in relocation when moving from abroad

title: Assistent horecamanager
description:
Deze Belgische retailorganisatie beheert een netwerk van shops in heel België, op locaties met dagelijks veel passanten en pendelaars.

  • Ze ontwikkelt moderne winkelconcepten voor klanten die onderweg snel willen stoppen voor snacks, koffie of een snelle maaltijd.
  • De shops zijn 7 dagen op 7 geopend en bieden een assortiment voor verschillende momenten van de dag, van ontbijt tot lunch of een korte pauze.
  • Binnen de winkels staan comfort, klantvriendelijkheid en efficiëntie centraal.
  • Elke shop heeft een hedendaagse uitstraling en is ingericht om klanten in korte tijd een aangename en vlotte winkelervaring te bieden.


Jobomschrijving

Als Assistant Manager bij Foodstation ben je de rechterhand van de manager en speel je een cruciale rol binnen ons gloednieuwe foodconcept.

Jouw takenpakket bestaat uit:

  • het coördineren van de foodservice
  • helpen bij het bereiden en serveren van gerechten wanneer nodig
  • het aansturen, motiveren en ondersteunen van het team
  • het voorraadbeheer en de bestellingen opvolgen
  • toezien op netheid, hygiëne en veiligheid in de keuken en de foodcorner
  • klanten vriendelijk ontvangen en een uitstekende service garanderen
  • samen met de manager zorgen voor een vlotte werking en fijne werksfeer

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

De perfecte Assistant Manager van het Foodstation herkent zich in onderstaande eigenschappen:

  • je hebt ervaring in de horeca of catering, je bent bij voorkeur vertrouwd met healthy fast food
  • je bent vertrouwd met het reilen en zeilen binnen retail food
  • je kan terugblikken op een eerste leidinggevende ervaring waarbij je een team moest aansturen
  • je bent enerzijds klantgericht, maar ook een echte teamplayer naar collega's toe
  • je bent flexibel inzetbaar en kan ook in het weekend werken
  • je bent energiek, positief en hands-on ingesteld
  • je kan goed plannen, organiseren en motiveren
De ideale collega is...

De ideale collega is een enthousiaste en gedreven teamplayer die energie haalt uit afwisseling en het coachen van een team.

Je hebt een passie voor voeding en de bereiding ervan en vindt het leuk om in een dynamische omgeving te werken waar geen dag hetzelfde is.

Je kan terugkijken op een eerste leidinggevende ervaring in een horeca-keten of een supermarkt, waarin het aansturen van collega's zeker aan bod kwam.

Organiseren, delegeren en actie ondernemen zijn jouw tweede natuur.

Je bent flexibel ingesteld en vindt het geen probleem om in het weekend te werken. Ook vroege en late uren (tussen 5u en 23u) schrikken jou niet af.

description:
Are you an experienced CE Driver who's living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home most evenings?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

  • Transport of frozen goods
  • National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
  • Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
  • Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

  • Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card
  • Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
  • Has a good level of English
  • Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
  • Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby truck cannot be taken home)

Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

  • You must already be living in Belgium
  • You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)

Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

title: Svensktalande E-Commerce Advisor i Bulgarien
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Concentrix Bulgaria is now looking for a number of dynamic and self-motivated Customer Advisors to join our exciting new project.

VF is the global company behind some of the world’s leading lifestyle brands including household names such as, Timberland, The North Face, Napapijri, Lee, Wrangler, Vans Eastpak and Kipling
Our aim is to consistently deliver world class customer service and we never lose sight of our goal - our customers are the focus of everything we do here! From email to phone in a multitude of languages, we’re on hand to offer care to all our customers to make sure they have a fun and enjoyable shopping experience with us.  

We’re an energetic, innovative and forward thinking team who are always looking for new ideas to delight and wow our customers.  The Customer Advisor is required to:

•    Be proficient (verbal & written) in Swedish
•    Be advanced in English
•    Be able to represent our client’s brands and deliver outstanding customer service with clarity, passion and enthusiasm
•    Be flexible to meet the changing needs and varying deadlines of our business
•    Be able to work to customer service measures, metrics and KPIs within a service targeted environment.
•    Hold a High-school or University degree
•    Possess excellent computer literacy
•    Have previous experience in a customer service environment, preferably telephone based.

Main responsibilities:

•    Communicating with customers by telephone, email and online to provide outstanding service
•    Building a rapport with customers to help them with enquiries including; order taking, product information, tracking deliveries, returns, sizing and quality queries
•    Discussing new products and managing multiple tasks to promptly resolve customer queries
•    Identifying ways to improve processes in order to improve sales, brand loyalty and the customer service and experience
•    Updating our systems with information and helping marketing, retail and other teams to further improve customer service and satisfaction.
Who are we:
Concentrix, a wholly owned subsidiary of SYNNEX Corporation (NYSE: SNX), is a leading business services company. We focus on customer engagement and improving business outcomes for over 450 global clients across many continents. Our 100,000+ staff deliver technology-infused, omni-channel customer experience management, marketing optimization, digital, consulting, analytics and back office solutions in 40+ languages from 125+ delivery centres. We serve automotive; banking and financial services; insurance; healthcare; technology; consumer electronics; media and communications; retail and e-commerce; travel and transportation; and energy and public-sector clients.

title: STROJOBRAVAR/STROJOBRAVARICA
description:
Pridružite se našem stručnom timu kao STROJOBRAVAR!

Ako imate iskustva u radu s različitim strojevima, te želite raditi u modernom okruženju s najnovijom tehnologijom, ovo je idealna prilika za vas!

Opis posla:

  • Priprema, podešavanje i vođenje strojeva
  • Popravak strojeva, preventivno i korektivno održavanje
  • Priprema dijelova za mjesečni zastoj (remont)
  • Održavanje i čišćenje radnog prostora i strojeva
  • Poštivanje sigurnosnih standarda i uputa na radu

Kvalifikacije:

  • Prethodno iskustvo rada kao strojobravar ili sl. (nije uvjet)
  • Poznavanje rada s različitim strojnim alatima
  • Sposobnost čitanja tehničkih crteža i shvaćanje tehničkih specifikacija
  • Pažljivost prema detaljima i visoka razina preciznosti u radu
  • Timski igrač s odličnim komunikacijskim vještinama
  • Spremnost na rad u smjenama
  • znanje kineskog jezika (prednost)

Ponuda:

  • Stalno zaposlenje s probnim rokom
  • Atraktivna i konkurentska plaća
  • Mogućnost napredovanja i usavršavanja kroz različite obuke
  • Rad u modernom i opremljenom radnom okruženju
  • Povoljni uvjeti rada i beneficije za zaposlenike

Ako ste spremni prihvatiti izazov i postati dio našeg uspješnog tima, pošaljite svoj životopis na kadrovska@kronospan.hr.

Molimo vas da naznačite naziv radnom mjesta „Strojobravar- oglas“ u naslovu e- pošte.

Zahvaljujemo na vašem interesu za rad u Kronospanu CRO d.o.o. Bjelovar, te očekujemo vaše prijave!

title: KOMERCIJALIST /KOMERCIJALISTICA
description:
Glavne odgovornosti:

  • Savjetovanje i podrška: Putem telefona i e-maila savjetuješ tvrtke na hrvatskom tržištu o tome kako najbolje iskoristiti našu platformu za preuzimanje visokokvalitetnih potencijalnih klijenata (leadova).
  • Analiza i rast prodaje: Analiziraš poslovne ciljeve klijenata, predlažeš optimalna rješenja unutar platforme i pratiš rezultate kako bi im osigurao kontinuiran rast prodaje.
  • Optimizacija rezultata: Redovito analiziraš uspješnost obrade leadova kod klijenata te pružaš strateške preporuke kako bi povećali stopu konverzije i ostvarili bolji povrat investicije.
  • Customer Support & Feedback: Brzo i profesionalno rješavaš sve upite, reklamacije i prijedloge klijenata, djelujući kao spona između njih i naše platforme.
  • Rad iz ureda: Posao se obavlja isključivo iz našeg ureda u Splitu (nije remote), što nam omogućuje bržu internu komunikaciju i bolju timsku sinergiju.

Uvjeti

  • Iskustvo u korisničkoj podršci, account managementu ili telefonskoj prodaji (računamo i studentski rad)
  • Empatija i sposobnost slušanja: razumiješ potrebe klijenata i pretvaraš ih u konkretne korake
  • Organiziran/a si, voliš timski rad i motiviraju te jasni ciljevi

Što nudimo:

  • Struktuirani onboarding, kontinuirane edukacije i mentorstvo
  • Motivirajući bonusi povezani s rezultatima tima i portfelja
  • Ured s prijateljskom atmosferom i povremenim team building aktivnostima

Zašto se pridružiti:

  • Napredovanje svakih 12 mjeseci
  • Vikendi i večeri su slobodni – rad-život balans nam je važan - radimo samo do 16h radnim danom
  • Moderna oprema, besplatna kava i tim koji dijeli znanje i iskustvo

Osiguravamo ti između 20 i 30 dana odmora, ovisno o tvojoj dobi i stažu unutar naše firme. Posebno cijenimo tvoje slobodno vrijeme, stoga potičemo korištenje dužeg godišnjeg odmora tijekom ljetnih mjeseci kako bi se u potpunosti napunio baterije.

title: SISTEM ADMINISTRATOR/ADMINISTRATORICA
description:
Tražimo sistem administratora/administratoricu za rad na implementaciji i održavanju ispisnih rješenja te povezane IT infrastrukture u enterprise okruženjima.

Glavne odgovornosti uključuju:

  • Implementaciju, nadzor i administraciju Canon ispisnih rješenja u enterprise okruženju
  • Implementaciju i održavanje serverske infrastrukture temeljene na Windows Server platformi
  • Integraciju ispisnih sustava u postojeću IT infrastrukturu klijenata
  • Pružanje tehničke podrške serviserima na terenu kod održavanja i nadogradnje ispisnih rješenja
  • Rješavanje problema vezanih uz printere, drivere i print servise

Tražimo:

  • Osnovno iskustvo u radu s ispisnim rješenjima (Canon uniFLOW, PaperCut i sl.)
  • Osnovno iskustvo u radu i administraciji Microsoft proizvoda (Active Directory, Group Policy, Print Server rola)
  • Osnovno iskustvo u administraciji mrežne infrastrukture (VLAN, DHCP, DNS, routing te konfiguracija firewall pravila za ispisne protokole)

Prednost ukoliko imate:

  • Iskustvo u radu s udaljenom podrškom (remote support)
  • Znanje PowerShella ili Basha (osnovni scripting)
  • Iskustvo s mrežnom opremom (MikroTik, Cambium i sl.)
  • Osnovno znanje Linux administracije

Profil kandidata

  • Analitičan pristup i izražena sklonost rješavanju tehničkih problema
  • Odgovornost i proaktivnost u radu
  • Razvijene komunikacijske vještine
  • Spremnost na rad s klijentima i biti podrška ekipi na terenu

title: VODITELJ/VODITELJICA ODRŽAVANJA
description:

  • Planiranje i organiziranje održavanja: izrada plana godišnjeg preventivnog održavanje, definira godišnje ciljeve i aktivnosti koji su uključeni u pripremu strategije tvrtke, sudjeluje u pripremi pokazatelja vrijednosti za ciljeve, sudjeluje u pripremi programa upravljanja okolišem koji su uključeni u planiranje i organiziranje investicijskih projekata, organiziranje provođenja redovitih mišljenja o stanju strojeva i opreme te otklanja pronađene pogreške.
  • Vodi i kontrolira provedbu investicijskih projekata i nadgleda provedbu redovitih preventivnih pregleda strojeva i uređaja, prati i daje izvješća o zastojima u radu i poteškoćama, kontrolira otklanjanje kvarova, potvrđuje interne naloge za održavanje, upravlja troškovima održavanja za postizanje ciljeva i maksimiziranje dobiti, priprema sve potrebne izvještaje.
  • Planira i izrađuje ciljeve za podređene zaposlenike, sudjeluje u izradi plana obrazovanja i osposobljavanja i osposobljavanja na radnom mjestu, utvrđuje učinkovitost obrazovanja i osposobljavanja, ocjenjuje rad i izvedbu podređenih zaposlenika, predlaže nagrade i promocije, organizira vođenje evidencije prisutnosti i odsutnosti s rada svojih podređenih, potiče zaposlenike na davanje korisnih prijedloga, organizira mentorstvo, potiče zaposlenike da prijavljuju eventualne opasnosti od nezgode i ozljede na radu.
  • Komunicira interno, te prema vani, voditelj je u procesu rada prema podređenim zaposlenicima i dobavljačima.
  • Sudjelovanje u procesu racionalizacije potrošnje energije.
  • Sudjelovanje u projektnim timovima, praćenje provedbe, kontrola projektne dokumentacije.
  • Poznavanje propisa i promjena u zakonodavstvu i njihovo uvođenje u provedbu postavljenih zadaća.
  • Za vrijeme svoje odsutnosti, iz bilo kojeg razloga, dužan je osigurati da se rad obavlja bez problema i osigurati zamjenu.
  • Obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu rukovoditelja.
  • Odgovornost za realizaciju planova održavanja u pogonu.
  • Odgovornost za funkcioniranje elektro i strojnog održavanja.
  • Odgovornost za rad u skladu sa Zakonom o radu, Zakonom o očuvanju okoliša i zahtjevima sustava ISO standarda.
  • Odgovornost za funkcionalnu i pouzdanu raspoloživost strojeva za proizvodnju.
  • Odgovornost za racionalno i učinkovito korištenje i naručivanje rezervnih dijelova.
  • Odgovornost za remonte i planirane zastoje stroja dogovara s voditeljem pogona i svojim nadređenim.
  • Odgovornost za upotrebu osobne zaštitne opreme i za poštovanje uputa za siguran rad svih podređenih.

title: 2. SPASILAC / SPASITELJICA
description: Na temelju članka 30. Statuta, ravnatelj ustanove Upravljanje sportskim objektima, Trg Krešimira Ćosića 11, Zagreb, raspisuje J AV N I N A T J E Č A J za prijam radnika u radni odnos na neodređeno vrijeme 2. Naziv radnog mjesta: SPASILAC (m/ž) – 4 izvršitelja/izvršiteljice Rad s punim radnim vremenom, neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 mjeseci Mjesto rada: Zagreb Sprema: VKV/SSS, važeće uvjerenje o osposobljenosti Hrvatskog Crvenog križa Koeficijent složenosti poslova: 1,61 Radno iskustvo: 1 godina Posebna znanja i vještine: nisu potrebna Opis poslova: vrši nadzor vodene površine s kopna ili čamca te površine bazena, provodi preventivne aktivnosti vezane uz sigurnost korisnika te brinu za sigurnost korisnika u smislu životne ugroze i spašavanja iz vode, pruža neodgodivu prvu pomoć, vrši neprekidan nadzor na svom području djelovanja za koje je zadužen i odgovoran tijekom u vremenu utvrđenom rasporedom, nadzire poštivanje bazenskog i plažnog reda, brine za čistoću bazena, raspored pruga, rekvizita i opreme na bazenu, jezeru ili plaži, dnevno obavlja čišćenje bazenskog oplošja i/ili plaže, sudjeluje u pripremi i realizaciji sportskih natjecanja ili drugih događanja na bazenu, jezeru ili plaži, osigurava natjecanja na vodi te druge manifestacije u blizini vode, daje informacije korisnicima u smislu uputa i pravila za korištenje bazena, jezera ili plaže, uz spasilačke poslove, sudjeluje kao ispomoć realizatorima sportskih programa u provođenju sportskih programa, provjere plivanja i dr., prema potrebi, obavlja redarske poslove na prostoru cijelog objekta, odgovoran je za stanje skladišta rekvizita i opreme, vodi pisanu evidenciju o dnevnom čišćenju bazena, intervencijama te oštećenjima na bazenu, jezeru ili plaži, sudjeluje u remontu bazena, prvenstveno u čišćenju školjke i oplošja bazena, obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu nadređenog u okviru stručne spreme i djelokruga rada. Plaću radnika čine osnovna odnosno ugovorena plaća i dodaci na osnovnu plaću. Osnovna plaća je umnožak koeficijenta složenosti poslova radnog mjesta na kojemu radnik radi i osnovice za izračun plaće, uvećan za 0,5 % za svaku navršenu godinu radnog staža. Osnovica za obračun plaće iznosi 1.075,94 eura bruto. Na javni natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Radni odnos se zasniva na neodređeno vrijeme, uz obavezni probni rad u trajanju od 6 mjeseci. Kandidati su u prijavi dužni navesti osobne podatke (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela, po mogućnosti e-mail adresa), naziv i redni broj radnog mjesta za koje se podnosi prijava. Kandidati koji se natječu za više radnih mjesta dužni su za svako radno mjesto podnijeti posebnu prijavu. Uz svaku prijavu dužni su priložiti traženu dokumentaciju. Kandidati su prilikom prijave dužni priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju: • prijavu za javni natječaj (obrazac prijave može se preuzeti na web-stranici Ustanove: https://www.sportskiobjekti.hr/pravilnici-i-natjecaji/1164), • životopis, • dokaz o državljanstvu (osobna iskaznica, putovnica, vojna iskaznica ili domovnica), • dokaz o stručnoj spremi: presliku diplome ili svjedodžbe (ukoliko kandidat uz prijavu priloži inozemnu kvalifikaciju, dužan je uz istu dostaviti i dokaz o priznavanju inozemne obrazovne kvalifikacije), • uvjerenje o nevođenju kaznenog postupka (ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave javnog natječaja), • uvjerenje o osposobljenosti Hrvatskog Crvenog križa (preslika uvjerenja) – za radno mjesto pod rednim brojem 2., • dokaz o ukupnom radnom iskustvu, ne stariji od 1 mjeseca od dana objave javnog natječaja: Elektronički zapis (e–radna knjižica) ili Potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje, a koji Zapis/Potvrda, između ostalih podataka, mora sadržavati i podatke o poslodavcu, početku i prestanku osiguranja, stvarnoj i potrebnoj stručnoj spremi, radnom vremenu, općini rada – prebivališta i trajanju staža osiguranja. Kandidati koji dostavljaju dokumentaciju na stranom jeziku dužni su uz istu dostaviti ovjereni prijevod na hrvatski jezik. Ukoliko kandidat uz prijavu priloži dokumente u kojima osobni podaci nisu istovjetni, dužan je dostaviti i dokaz o njihovoj promjeni (presliku vjenčanog ili rodnog lista). Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužan je u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Da bi ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, kandidat koji ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava, dužan je uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja, kao i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu o priznatom statusu, te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (ugovor, rješenje, odluka i sl.) Temeljem članka 103. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihove obitelji (Narodne novine, 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23) i članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, 84/21), kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti dužni su dostaviti sve dokaze iz citiranih odredbi Zakona. Dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju objavljeni su na Internet stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja Republike Hrvatske https://branitelji.gov.hr/pristup-informacijama/835 . Kandidat koji se, sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20), poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja, dužan je uz prijavu na natječaj, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i dokumentaciju navedenu u javnom natječaju. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz javnog natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na javni natječaj. Kandidati prijavljeni na javni natječaj bit će pozvani pisanim putem na prethodnu provjeru znanja i sposobnosti bitnih za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se primaju. Prethodnoj provjeri znanja i sposobnosti mogu pristupiti samo kandidati koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja. Ako kandidat ne pristupi prethodnoj provjeri znanja, smatra se da je povukao prijavu na javni natječaj i više se ne smatra kandidatom. Rok za podnošenje prijava je 8 (osam) dana od dana objave javnog natječaja u novinama, na web-stranici i oglasnoj ploči HZZ-a te na web-stranici i oglasnoj ploči ustanove Upravljanje sportskim objektima. Prijave s naznakom „ZA NATJEČAJ – PRIJAM U RADNI ODNOS – NAZIV I REDNI BROJ RADNOG MJESTA ZA KOJE SE PODNOSI PRIJAVA“ dostavljaju se na adresu: Upravljanje sportskim objektima, Baštijanova 52a, 10 000 Zagreb. Ustanova Upravljanje sportskim objektima zadržava pravo poništenja natječaja, u cijelosti i/ili u dijelu, odnosno pravo ne odabrati niti jednog kandidata, bez obveze obrazlaganja svoje odluke i bez ikakve odgovornosti prema kandidatima. title: PROJEKTANT SURADNIK/PROJEKTANTICA SURADNICA
description:
PROJEKTANT SURADNIK (m/ž)

Za rad u projektantskom uredu tražimo motiviranu i odgovornu osobu za radno mjesto Projektant suradnik (m/ž).

Opis posla

Projektant suradnik sudjeluje u izradi arhitektonskih projekata kroz različite faze projektiranja, u suradnji s glavnim projektantom i ostalim članovima projektnog tima.

Glavne odgovornosti uključuju:

  • sudjelovanje u izradi idejnih, glavnih i izvedbenih projekata

  • izradu i razradu arhitektonske projektne dokumentacije

  • izradu tehničkih nacrta, detalja i grafičkih priloga

  • sudjelovanje u razvoju projektnih rješenja

  • usklađivanje projektne dokumentacije s ostalim strukama

  • pripremu dokumentacije za ishođenje potrebnih dozvola i suglasnosti

  • komunikaciju i koordinaciju s kolegama, suradnicima i ostalim sudionicima u projektu

  • praćenje projekta i izvršavanje zadataka prema dogovorenim rokovima

  • sudjelovanje u obilascima lokacija i gradilišta prema potrebi

Uvjeti i očekivanja

Od kandidata očekujemo:

  • završeno odgovarajuće obrazovanje iz područja arhitekture, graditeljstva ili srodnog tehničkog područja

  • poznavanje rada u relevantnim programima za projektiranje i izradu tehničke dokumentacije

  • preciznost, odgovornost i organiziranost

  • sposobnost timskog rada i kvalitetne komunikacije

  • samostalnost u izvršavanju povjerenih zadataka u skladu s razinom iskustva

  • spremnost na učenje i profesionalni razvoj

Radno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima je prednost, ali razmotrit ćemo i kandidate s manje iskustva koji pokazuju znanje, motivaciju i želju za učenjem.

Mjesto i način rada

Rad se obavlja na licu mjesta, u prostorijama projektantskog ureda.

Tražimo osobu koja će biti svakodnevno prisutna u uredu i aktivno sudjelovati u radu projektnog tima. Ovo radno mjesto nije predviđeno za rad na daljinu (remote) niti isključivo online suradnju.

Što nudimo

  • rad na raznovrsnim arhitektonskim i projektantskim zadacima

  • rad u profesionalnom i suradničkom okruženju

  • mogućnost učenja i razvoja stručnih znanja

  • sudjelovanje u svim fazama razvoja projekta

  • stabilnu i dugoročnu suradnju

  • mogućnost profesionalnog napredovanja u skladu sa znanjem, iskustvom i rezultatima

Ako ste zainteresirani za rad u projektantskom uredu i želite biti dio tima koji zajednički razvija i realizira projekte, pozivamo vas da nam pošaljete svoj životopis i, ako je primjenjivo, portfolio dosadašnjih rad

title: STROJOBRAVAR / STROJOBRAVARICA
description:
Pridružite se Knauf Insulationu – kompaniji gdje su svi važni!

U Knauf Insulationu vidimo priliku u svakome. Naša svrha je jasna: „Make tomorrow home for all of us“ – stvaramo bolje sutra za sve nas. Da bismo to postigli, gradimo tim koji cijeni raznolikost, gdje je svaki član jednako važan. U Knauf Insulationu vjerujemo da svi zaslužuju sigurno i uključivo okruženje u kojem mogu napredovati. Vaše osobine, stavovi, ponašanje i vrijednosti su ono što vas čini posebnima – zato ste nam važni baš vi, kao osoba. Ako želite raditi u kompaniji koja cijeni vaše jedinstvene talente i doprinos, Knauf Insulation je pravo mjesto za vas!

Pridruži nam se u Odjel održavanja na radno mjesto Strojobravara kako bismo zajedno gradili bolje sutra!

Možete li reći 'da'?

  • Imate iskustva u održavanju opreme?
  • Poštujete li uvijek pravila o sigurnosti na radu?
  • Volite li tražiti prilike za rast i razvoj?

Naš idealan kandidat/kandidatkinja obavljat će preventivne preglede i održavanje strojeva i opreme kako bi osigurali neprekidan rada proizvodnje. Jeste li spremni pridružiti nam se na našem izazovnom putovanju?

Što ćete raditi:

  • obavljati preventivne preglede strojeva i opreme
  • obavljati poslove redovnog i interventnog održavanja opreme
  • voditi evidenciju obavljenih pregleda i popravaka
  • samostalno izrađivati alate i naprave
  • sudjelovati u intervencijama u slučaju kvara.

Što bismo voljeli da imate:

  • KV/SSS tehničkog usmjerenja ( mehatroničar, strojarski tehničar, strojobravar, mehaničar)
  • poželjno 2 godine iskustva na sličnim poslovima
  • u svakodnevnom radu spremni ste demonstrirati ponašanja sukladna Knauf vrijednostima: Menschlichkeit, Commitment, Entrepreneurship i Partnership.

Vi ste nam važni kao osoba: vaši stavovi, ponašanje i vrijednosti su ono što nas zanima. Ako nemate sve navedene vještine za ovu ulogu, ali ste voljni učiti i razvijati se, rado bismo s vama razgovarali.

Pružamo:

  • ugovor o radu na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rok od 6 mjeseca
  • mogućnost kontinuiranog usavršavanja i napredovanja
  • stimulativna primanja, regres, božićnicu, uskrsnicu, naknadu za topli obrok, plaćen puni iznos prijevoza
  • preventivni sistematski pregled, Multisport karticu.

Što dalje?

Cijenimo vaše dragocjeno vrijeme te smo svjesni kako prijava za novi posao može biti dugotrajan proces - zato smo se obvezali odgovoriti na vašu prijavu u roku od 10 radnih dana.

Mjesto rada: Varaždinska 140, Novi Marof .

Prijave primamo putem linka Bravar (m/ž) - Knauf Insulation Systems Division .

Kontakt osoba : Ivana Vrban, Talent Acquisition Specialist.

title: SISTEM INŽENJER/KA
description:
Osatina Grupa d.o.o. je u potrazi za stručnim i motiviranim Sistem inženjerom (m/ž) koji će se pridružiti našem IT timu. Ako imaš iskustva u održavanju poslužiteljske infrastrukture, voliš rješavati tehničke izazove i želiš raditi u dinamičnom okruženju, ovo je prilika za tebe! OPIS POSLA Kao Sistem inženjer, bit ćeš ključna osoba za osiguravanje stabilnosti, sigurnosti i optimalnih performansi naše IT infrastrukture. Tvoji glavni zadaci uključivat će:
  • virtualizacija i serveri: Instalacija, konfiguracija i proaktivno održavanje Windows servera te upravljanje Hyper-V virtualizacijskom okolinom i virtualnim strojevima (VM).
  • sigurnost podataka: Konfiguracija, nadzor i redovito testiranje sustava za sigurnosnu pohranu (backup) i oporavak podataka korištenjem Veeam rješenja.
  • upravljanje domenom: Administracija Active Directoryja (upravljanje korisničkim računima, grupama, pravima pristupa i GPO politikama).
  • file serveri: Održavanje i strukturiranje mrežnih dijeljenih mapa (File servers), dodjeljivanje prava i praćenje dostupnosti.
  • korisnička podrška i oprema: Instalacija, održavanje i rješavanje problema na radnim računalima (hardware i software) te konfiguracija mrežnih printera i ostale periferne opreme.
  • nadzor sustava: Praćenje rada cjelokupnog informacijskog sustava i pravovremeno rješavanje tehničkih poteškoća.
UVJETI
  • minimalno 1 godina radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima.
  • napredno poznavanje Microsoft Windows Server okruženja je prednost.
  • praktično iskustvo s Hyper-V tehnologijom virtualizacije.
  • iskustvo u radu s Veeam Backup & Replication alatima.
  • odlično poznavanje Active Directory, DNS, DHCP servisa.
  • sposobnost samostalnog rješavanja problema s računalima (Windows 10/11) i perifernom opremom (printeri, skeneri).
  • poznavanje osnovnih mrežnih koncepata (LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, VPN)
ŠTO NUDIMO
  • ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rok.
  • pristup najnovijim tehnologijama.
Kako se prijaviti? Ako prepoznaješ sebe u ovom opisu i želiš postati dio našeg tima, pošalji nam svoj životopis (CV) i kratko motivacijsko pismo na e-mail adresu: natjecaji@osatina.hr s naslovom "Prijava za posao: Sistem inženjer". Natječaj ostaje otvoren do 14.08.2026. Samo kandidati koji uđu u uži krug bit će kontaktirani. Radujemo se tvojoj prijavi!

Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata, navedene na mrežnoj stranici Ministarstva Hrvatskih branitelja Republike Hrvatske na poveznici https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, sukladno čl. 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“, br. 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03,148/13 i 98/19), uz prijavu na Javni poziv dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, potvrdu o nezaposlenosti Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje izdanom u vrijeme trajanja Javnog poziva, te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.). Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s članka 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20) dokazuje to odgovarajućom javnom ispravom o invaliditetu na temelju koje se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom, te dokazom iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.). Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju temeljem nekog drugog posebnog zakona dužni su u prijavi na Javni poziv pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti preslike rješenja ili potvrde o priznatom pravu te svu ostalu dokumentaciju temeljem koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti. Kandidat koji je stekao inozemnu obrazovnu kvalifikaciju u inozemstvu dužan je u prijavi na Javni poziv priložiti rješenje Agencije za znanost i visoko obrazovanje o stručnom priznavanju inozemne visokoškolske kvalifikacije u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju i vrednovanju inozemnih obrazovnih kvalifikacija („Narodne novine“ broj 69/22.) te u skladu sa Zakonom o reguliranim profesijama i priznavanju inozemnih stručnih kvalifikacija („Narodne novine“ broj 82/15, 70/19, 47/20, 123/23.) Rok za podnošenje prijava s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz Javnog poziva počinje teći od 3.8.2026. te iste moraju biti zaprimljene najkasnije do 11.8.2026. do 14,00 sati na adresi Škole. Prijave se dostavljanju neposredno ili poštom na adresu: Srednja škola Zvane Črnje Rovinj, Scuola media superiore “Zvane Črnja” Rovigno, Carduccijeva ulica 20, 52210 Rovinj-Rovigno) s naznakom „Javni poziv za obavljanje poslova pomoćnika u nastavi za učenike s teškoćama u razvoju“. Zainteresirani za zaposlenje u više škola dostavljaju sve dokumente u sve škole, a u prijavi trebaju navesti škole po redoslijedu interesa. Potpunom prijavom smatra se ona koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u Javnom pozivu te koja je vlastoručno potpisana. Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave neće biti razmatrane. Radni odnos sa školom će se zasnivati nakon provedenog postupka selekcije kandidata. Sve kandidate koji su dostavili pravodobnu i potpunu prijavu pozvati će se na procjenu. Ako kandidat ne pristupi procjeni smatrati će se da je odustao od prijave na Javni poziv. Obavijest i uputa o vremenu i datumu održavanja selekcijskog postupka objavit će se i na mrežnim stranicama Škole ( https://ss-zcrnje-rovinj.skole.hr/natjecaji/ ). Kandidat prijavljen na Javni poziv bit će obaviješten o rezultatima Javnog poziva putem mrežne stranice Škole ( https://ss-zcrnje-rovinj.skole.hr/natjecaji/ ). Osobe koje se prijave na Javni poziv podnošenjem prijave daju svoju suglasnost Srednjoj školi Zvane Črnje Rovinj, Scuola media superiore ''Zvane Črnja'' Rovigno, da u njoj navedene osobne podatke prikuplja i obrađuje u svrhu zapošljavanja, te da ih može koristiti i u svrhu kontaktiranja i objave na svojim internetskim stranicama i/ili oglasnoj ploči. Izrazi koji se koriste u ovome Javnom pozivu, a imaju rodno značenje, odnose se jednako na muški i ženski rod. RAVNATELJICA Ingrid Sau, prof. Dostaviti: 1. Hrvatski zavod za zapošljavanje, 2. Oglasna ploča, ovdje 3. Mrežne stranice, 4. Dea Blažina, UO za obrazovanje, sport i tehničku kulturu, putem dea.blazina@istra-istria.hr 5. Anja Šumberac, UO za obrazovanje, sport i tehničku kulturu, 6. putem anja.sumberac@istra-istria.hr 7. Pismohrana, ovdje

title: EKONOM/EKONOMKA
description: DOM ZA STARIJE I NEMOĆNE OSOBE „ATILIO GAMBOC“ UMAG CENTRO PER ANZIANI E DISABILI „ATILIO GAMBOC“ UMAGO ULICA 154. BRIGADE HRVATSKE VOJSKE 5 52470 UMAG OIB: 72427815354 U Umagu, 04.kolovoza. 2026. godine Temeljem Zakona o socijalnoj skrbi (N.N.br., 18/22,46/22, 119/22,71/23) i članka 32. Statuta Doma, zaključka Gradonačelnika i suglasnosti Upravnog vijeća Doma za starije i nemoćne osobe – Centro per anziani e disabili „Atilio Gamboc“ Umag - Umago, Ravnateljica Doma raspisuje NATJEČAJ za prijem u radni odnos 1. EKONOM JEDAN (1) izvršitelj (m/ž) na neodređeno puno radno vrijeme UVJETI ZA PRIJEM U RADNI ODNOS: Kandidati moraju ispunjavati opće uvjete za zasnivanje radnog odnosa (punoljetnost, hrvatsko državljanstvo i zdravstvena sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se osoba prima) te sljedeće posebne uvjete: AD 1. EKONOM • Stručna sprema – završeno četverogodišnje srednjoškolsko obrazovanje • Posebni uvjeti - poznavanje talijanskog jezika, poznavanje rada na računalu i Certifikat u području javne nabave • Probni rad – 3 mjeseca Odgovornost: Ravnatelju Na Natječaj se mogu javiti kandidati oba spola. Ugovor o radu sklapa se uz uvjet probnog rada u trajanju od tri (3) mjeseca. Sa kandidatima prijavljenim na natječaj koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete a koji temeljem kompetencija navedenih u životopisu uđu u uži krug izbora, Ravnateljica i Upravno vijeće Doma ili posebno Povjerenstvo koje će biti oformljeno za provedbu natječajnog postupka, obaviti će intervju, o čemu će kandidati biti obaviješteni pismenim putem. Ako kandidat ne pristupi intervjuu u utvrđeno vrijeme, smatrat će se da je povukao prijavu na natječaj. Pozivaju se osobe iz članka 102. stavak 1.- 3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne Novine“ broj 121/17,98/19,84/21 ) da uz prijavu na natječaj dostave i dokaze iz članka 103. stavka 1. prethodno navedenog Zakona; Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843 Pozivaju se osobe iz čl. 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“ 84/21.) da uz prijavu na natječaj dostave i dokaze iz članka 49. prethodno navedenog Zakona. Poveznica na Internet stranici Narodnih novina: https://narodne-novine.nn.hr/eli/sluzbeni/2021/84/1555 Dodatne informacije o dokazima koji su potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju mogu se potražiti na sljedećim poveznicama: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf odnosno https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidat koji ima pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužan je u prijavi na oglas pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti odgovarajuće isprave kao dokaz o statusu te druge dokaze sukladno posebnom zakonu kojim je uređeno to pravo, a ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu sa čl. 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne Novine“ broj 121/17.98/19,84/21) , čl. 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (NN br. 32/19;57/92;77/92;27/93;2/94;76/94;108/95;108/96;82/01;103/03;148/13 i 98/19), čl. 9 Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN br. 157/13;152/14;39/18 i 32/20) dužan se u prijavi na oglas pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s čl. 9 Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom uz prijavu na oglas dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta ovim oglasom, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Uz prijavu na Natječaj kandidati moraju dostaviti slijedeće dokumente: - životopis, - presliku osobne iskaznice, - presliku diplome/svjedodžbe o završenoj školi (dokaz stručnosti prema uvjetima iz Natječaja) – obična preslika, - dokaz ili izjavu o poznavanju rada na računalu - dokaz ili izjavu o poznavanju Talijanskog jezika - Certifikat s područja javne nabave-obična preslika - elektronički zapis o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje ( u slučaju da je osiguranik podnio zahtjev u elektroničkom obliku preko korisničkih stranica Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje), odnosno potvrdu za mirovinsko osiguranje koju Zavod na osobno traženje osiguranika izdaje na šalterima područnih službi/ureda HZMO ( ne starije od 30 dana, računajući od dana objave oglasa na oglasnoj ploči Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje)- obična preslika - elektronički zapis ili obična preslika uvjerenja nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata/kinje ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starijeg od tri mjeseca, računajući od dana objave oglasa na oglasnoj ploči Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje). Prijave na Natječaj s potrebnim dokazima o ispunjenju uvjeta slati na adresu: Dom za starije i nemoćne osobe „Atilio Gamboc“ Umag Ulica 154. brigade Hrvatske vojske br. 5. 52470 Umag „Prijava po Natječaju za prijem u radni odnos – ne otvaraj“ (Ekonom) U razmatranje će se uzeti samo pravovaljane i pravovremeno pristigle prijave. Pravovaljana prijava je ona prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju, u obliku navedenom u natječaju. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravovaljanu i pravodobnu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se prijavljenim kandidatom, a toj osobi će biti dostavljena pisana obavijest u kojoj će biti navedeni razlozi zbog kojih se ne smatra kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj. Osoba nema pravo podnošenja pravnog lijeka protiv te obavijesti. Natječaj je otvoren 15 (petnaest) dana od dana objave na mrežnim stranicama www.umag.hr; www.dom-umag.hr; www.burzarada.hr te oglasnim pločama Grada Umaga, Doma „Atilio Gamboc“ Umag , i HZZ -a. O rezultatima oglasa kandidati će biti obaviješteni u zakonskom roku, dostavom obavijesti o prijemu na rad izabranog kandidata ili dostavom odluke o poništenju natječaja. Ravnateljica Doma Diana Lekić, mag. oec.
