title: PhD scholarship in Fast-Tracking Innovation through Technology Implementation - DTU Engineering Technology
description:
If you are passionate about innovation and technology and wish to contribute to developing knowledge, methods, and tools that will help companies, organisations and society, join us for a PhD project at DTU Engineering Technology. You will work at the intersection between research and industry in an application-focused environment and influence how technology succeeds in practice by focusing on technology implementation in Danish SMEs.

The PhD project will study how SMEs transition through technology implementation towards structured innovation processes, e.g. to fasten the time-to-market of new products. When SMEs become established and implement new technology, they often transition from being agile, customer centric and entrepreneurial to more structured and focused on internal processes. In doing so, they lose the startup approach, which results in longer time-to-market for new products.

The project will follow the journey of navigating the complexity of technology implementation in multiple Danish SMEs over time, and the successful candidate will define and pursue a research project within this frame. Relevant perspectives include innovation management, technology implementation, human-centred design, and organisational management. The project is expected to combine rigorous empirical research with the development and evaluation of new approaches, contributing both to academic knowledge and to the advancement of educational practices at DTU.

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your overall focus will be to develop and conduct research on SMEs transitions through technology implementation towards structured innovation processes. You will contribute to both research and teaching activities within DTU Engineering Technology.

Your primary tasks will be to:
  • Develop and execute an independent PhD research project within technology implementation
  • Study the impact of organizational and contextual changes on technology implementation outcomes within the context of Danish SMEs
  • Design and evaluate a practice-based toolset define the combinations of methods and tools for technology implementation
  • Collect and analyse empirical data using qualitative and/or quantitative methods
  • Publish research findings in high-quality academic journals and conferences
  • Contribute to teaching, supervision, and development of courses and learning activities
  • Collaborate with colleagues and partners across DTU Engineering Technology

The ideal candidate has an educational background relevant to innovation management, technology implementation or organisational management. Applicants must be fluent in English and Danish.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education.

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. The allowance will be agreed upon with the relevant union. The period of employment is 3 years.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
Further information may be obtained from Associate Professor Giulia Nardelli (ginar@dtu.dk).

You can read more about DTU Engineering Technology at https://engtech.dtu.dk/english.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU.

Application procedure
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 9 August 2026 (23:59 Danish time).

Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:
  • A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
  • Curriculum vitae
  • Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale

You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

About DTU Engineering Technology
We work at the forefront of university-industry collaboration and develop tools and methods for technology implementation. We are organized in 8 sections all focused on technology implementation, engineering technology and engineering education within a wide range of engineering fields.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. title: Bliv Social- og Sundhedshjælperelev i Morsø Kommune med opstart den 18. november 2026
description:
Vil du gøre en stor forskel for andre? - så har vi brug for dig

Har du en studentereksamen bliver din uddannelse som social-og sundhedshjælper afkortet og du kan tage GF2 på kun 8 uger fra den 18. november 2026 og går derefter videre til hovedforløbet.

Med en social-og sundhedshjælper uddannelse bliver du en del af frontpersonalet, der i dén grad gør en forskel for de borgere, der har brug for praktisk hjælp og personlig pleje.

Om os
Vores kerneopgave i Center for Sundhed og Ældre er at støtte borgeren til et sundt og værdigt liv. Det betyder i praksis, at vi arbejder aktivt, professionelt og tværfagligt på at finde frem til de bedste løsninger for kommunens borgere, gennem inddragelse af borgerne og de pårørende.
I Morsø Kommune vil vi gerne gå forrest og derfor vil du opleve, at der på alle oplæringssteder arbejdes med udvikling af nye tiltag med fokus på kerneopgaven.


Vi kan tilbyde: 

  • Ansættelse i et sammenhængende forløb fra start til slut
  • Løn under uddannelsen 
  • Et fagligt stærkt og veltilrettelagt uddannelsesforløb
  • Et uformelt og godt læringsmiljø med plads til refleksion
  • En arbejdsplads hvor DU er en vigtig del af holdet
  • Gode jobmuligheder efter endt uddannelse

 

Du får lagt fundamentet for at gå ind på en udviklende, fagligt udfordrende og spændende uddannelse, hvor du får støtte fra uddannelsesleder og oplæringsvejledere gennem hele uddannelsen.

Vi forventer: 

  • At du kan og vil tage ansvar for egen uddannelse og læring, i samarbejde med skolen, dine oplæringsvejledere og uddannelsesleder
  • At du har lyst og evne til at reflektere over egen praksis
  • At du er opsøgende og nysgerrig
  • At du er medspiller på vores hold af gode medarbejdere
  • At du er god til at opbygge og vedligeholde relationer
  • At du er ansvarsbevidst og kan bevare overblikket
  • Er forberedt på skiftende arbejdstider: dag, aften og weekend


Adgangskravet til et afkortet GF2
Du skal have en nordisk studentereksamen (STX, HHX, HTX el.lign.)

Optagelse på VEVO-skolen, Thisted afdeling via www.optagelse.dk

Ansøgningsfrist til os senest den 2. september 2026
Samtaler forventes den 8. september 2026

Kontakt uddannelsesleder Annette Sø på abso@morsoe.dk eller 9970 6356/ 2445 4612 for yderligere oplysninger.
Ring og forhør nærmere om netop dine muligheder.

Øvrige oplysninger
Stillingen er på 37 timer i ugen.
Du ansættes i Morsø Kommune og vil blive introduceret inden opstart.
Du skal selv afholde udgifter til bøger, PC og andet nødvendigt materiale, der benyttes
på uddannelsen.
Det er en fordel, hvis du har kørekort.
Løn betales bagud.

Udenlandske statsborgere skal vedlægge kopi af arbejds- og opholdstilladelse.

Husk at vedhæfte relevante dokumenter, såsom eksamensbeviser, dokumentation for
ansættelser, CV og en motiveret ansøgning på ca. en A4-side.
Du kan også vedhæfte udtalelser fra tidligere arbejdspladser eller uddannelser.
Hvis du bliver tilbudt en stilling, vil du umiddelbart efter samtalen, skulle møde ind på Morsø Kommune for at underskrive din uddannelsesaftale

Vær opmærksom på at dine data vil blive delt med VEVO skolen i Thisted, hvis du
ansættes, for at afklare dit uddannelsesforløb. Morsø Kommune journaliserer dine data når du henvender dig vedrørende uddannelse.
Vi skal gøre opmærksom på, at såfremt du får afslag på din ansøgning om elevstilling, er Morsø Kommune forpligtet til at registrere afslaget – herunder f.eks. dit navn, adresse, telefonnummer, e-mail eller CPR-nummer.
Oplysningerne registreres på Praktikpladsen.dk og overføres til Datavarehuset i Styrelsen for IT og Læring. Oplysningerne indsamles udelukkende til statistiske formål. De registrerede oplysninger er ikke synlige for dig eller offentligheden. Indsamlingen af disse data sker med hjemmel i §58 i bekendtgørelser om Erhvervsuddannelser.

title: Lead Data Engineer (m/w/d) (Data Engineer)
description:
Als **Lead Data Engineer (m/w/d)** verbindest du hands-on Engineering mit technischer Führung und prägst die Weiterentwicklung unseres Databricks-basierten Datenökosystems. Du spielst eine zentrale Rolle bei der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Datenplattform. Du arbeitest eng mit Engineers, Architekt:innen, Product Ownern und Business-Stakeholdern zusammen und triffst technische Entscheidungen, die sowohl kurzfristige Anforderungen als auch langfristige strategische Ziele unterstützen. Du verstehst, wie die Arbeit des Engineering-Teams zu konkreten Geschäftsergebnissen beiträgt.

Über das Unternehmen

Die DLG-Gruppe zählt zu den führenden Genossenschaften Europas in den Bereichen Lebensmittel, Energie und Baustoffe. Unser Auftrag ist es, langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere landwirtschaftlichen Eigentümer und für die Gesellschaft zu schaffen – durch verlässliche Produkte, innovative Lösungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum in all unseren Geschäftsbereichen. Mit rund 7.000 Mitarbeitenden in 18 Ländern und auf Basis unserer genossenschaftlichen Struktur gestalten wir unsere Zukunft durch gemeinsame Werte, nachhaltige Ziele und den festen Glauben an die Kraft der Zusammenarbeit.

Die team SE mit Sitz in Flensburg ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der DLG-Gruppe. Unsere zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen sind standortübergreifend zwischen Flensburg und dem DLG-Hauptsitz in Fredericia organisiert. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir die Geschäftsbereiche über Ländergrenzen hinweg und tragen zu einer effizienten, integrierten und zukunftsfähigen Organisation bei, die Skaleneffekte und Synergien optimal nutzt.

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für das Data-Engineering-Team und prägst maßgeblich die technische Ausrichtung unserer Data-Engineering-Praktiken im gesamten Unternehmen. Som kok er du en del af vores køkkenhold og sørger for, at vores gæster hver dag får et gastronomisk tilbud af høj kvalitet og med stor variation.

Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

- Et køligt hoved – også i stressede situationer
- Teamånd, pålidelighed og en struktureret arbejdsmåde
- Kreativitet og interesse for forskellige køkkenretninger
- Fleksibilitet og villighed til også at arbejde i weekender og på helligdage
- Gode danskkundskaber; engelsk- eller tyskfærdigheder er en fordel

title: Vorrichter/Rohrschlosser (m/w/d) (Rohrvorrichter/in)
description:
Unsere Berufung ist die Planung, Herstellung, Lieferung, Montage und Inbetriebnahme von Dampfturbosätzen, mit denen wir den individuellen Kundenbedürfnissen vollumfänglich gerecht werden.

Wir kombinieren erstklassige Qualität mit effektiven und sicheren Prozessen und hinterfragen unser Denken und Handeln stets auf Nachhaltigkeit in Bezug auf unsere Produkte, die Umwelt sowie die Gesundheit und Entwicklung unserer Beschäftigten.

Als Arbeitgeber sind wir ein professionell agierender Mittelständler (mit derzeit ca.195 Mitarbeitern), der sich die Flexibilität und Handlungsschnelligkeit aus der Gründungszeit durch kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien beibehalten hat. In diesem Geist denken wir lösungsorientiert und pragmatisch, sind mutig und entscheidungsfreudig und können somit schnell und zielorientiert im Sinne des Kunden und der Mitarbeiter reagieren.

Da wir stetig wachsen, suchen wir als Verstärkung ab sofort eine(n)

Vorrichter/Rohrschlosser (m/w/d)

So passt du zu uns:

- Du übernimmst Verantwortung für dein Handeln gegenüber unseren Kunden und Kollegen.
- Du arbeitest gerne in einem Team, da du Spaß daran hast, vernetzt zu sein und über deinen Bereich hinaus zu denken.
- Dir ist eine gerade und direkte, aber auch respektvolle und anerkennende Kommunikation sehr wichtig.
- Du schätzt es, wenn ein Unternehmen nicht nur Loyalität von dir erwartet, sondern sich auch für seine Mitarbeiter einsetzt.
- Du bist authentisch und integer, lebst deine eigenen Wertvorstellungen und Überzeugungen und bringst dabei Ecken und Kanten mit.
- Du hast Spaß am Umgang mit internationalen Kunden, bist reisebereit und kannst Dich gut auf Deutsch und Englisch ausdrücken - vielleicht beherrscht Du sogar noch eine weitere Fremdsprache.
****
Das verantwortest du:
-  Du übernimmst bei der Montage unserer Dampfturbosätze die Vorrichtarbeiten für den Rohrleitungsbau.

Das erwarten wir von dir:

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Rohrschlosser oder im Bereich Metallbau, Schweißtechnik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.
- Einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Rohrleitungsbau
- Hohe Reisebereitschaft und Flexibilität (80% Außendienst).
- Sicherer Umgang mit den üblichen schweißtechnischen Dokumenten, eigenständiges Arbeiten nach Planungsunterlagen/Isometrien.
- Führerschein Klasse B.
- Technisches Verständnis.

Das bieten wir dir:

-  30 Tage Urlaub/Jahr

- Mitarbeiterangebote über Corporate Benefit Programm
- Fahrradleasing als geldwerter Vorteil
- Zuschuss zu Hansefit-Mitgliedschaft (nach 2-jähriger Zugehörigkeit)
- Zuschuss zu Betrieblicher Altersvorsorge oder VWL
- Arbeitgeberfinanzierte Unfallversicherung (auch für private Unfälle)

title: Manager søges til Restaurant Odette
description:
Floor Manager til ODETTE

Brænder du for gastronomi, ledelse og den gode stemning på gulvet?

Restaurant ODETTE søger en engageret og nærværende Floor Manager, der har lyst til at være den samlende kraft under service og sikre, at både gæster og medarbejdere får den bedst mulige oplevelse.

ODETTE er en del af Norrlyst-koncernen, og vores gæster kommer for at opleve både kvalitet, varme og personlighed. Til frokost serverer vi nyfortolket dansk smørrebrød, lavet med omtanke og kærlighed til håndværket. Om aftenen inviterer vi til social dining med en 12-retters menu, hvor vi skaber små øjeblikke af nærvær og oplevelser ved bordet.

Nu søger vi en Floor Manager, der trives med ansvar, elsker service og motiveres af at skabe struktur, overblik og god energi på gulvet.

Hvem er du?

Du elsker restaurantlivet og motiveres af at være tæt på både gæster og kollegaer. Du er en naturlig holdspiller, der går forrest, bevarer overblikket i travle perioder og skaber ro, retning og arbejdsglæde omkring dig.

Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring som Floor Manager, tjener eller i en lignende koordinerende rolle

  • Trives i et travlt miljø og holder hovedet koldt, når tempoet er højt

  • Er struktureret, ansvarsbevidst og løsningsorienteret

  • Har gode samarbejdsevner og motiverer dine kollegaer gennem dit engagement

  • Brænder for værtskab og exceptionelle gæsteoplevelser

  • Har interesse for mad, vin og gastronomi

  • Er professionel, imødekommende og serviceminded i din tilgang

Dine opgaver

Som Floor Manager hos ODETTE bliver du en nøgleperson i den daglige service og ansvarlig for, at restauranten fungerer optimalt under åbningstiden.

Du vil blandt andet få ansvar for:

  • At lede og koordinere den daglige service på gulvet

  • At sikre et højt serviceniveau og en gennemført gæsteoplevelse

  • At fordele opgaver og skabe et godt flow under service

  • At være bindeled mellem køkkenet og serveringsteamet

  • At støtte, motivere og udvikle medarbejderne i den daglige drift

  • At håndtere gæstehenvendelser og sikre høj gæstetilfredshed

  • At bidrage til oplæring af nye medarbejdere

  • At sikre, at restauranten altid fremstår præsentabel og klar til service

Vi tilbyder

Hos ODETTE bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor faglighed og fællesskab går hånd i hånd. Vi arbejder professionelt, men tror på, at arbejdsglæde og gode relationer skaber de bedste oplevelser – både for gæster og medarbejdere.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En varm, social og ambitiøs arbejdsplads

  • Et stærkt team med hjælpsomme og engagerede kollegaer

  • Mulighed for faglig og ledelsesmæssig udvikling

  • En flad organisation med masser af dialog og ansvar

  • Tæt samarbejde med restaurantchefen og resten af lederteamet

  • Gode karrieremuligheder i hele Norrlyst-koncernen

  • Gode personalerabatter

  • En hverdag med fart på, højt humør og fokus på kvalitet

Har du lyst til at blive en central del af et dedikeret team, hvor værtskab, kvalitet og nærvær er i centrum, og hvor du får mulighed for at tage ansvar og udvikle både mennesker og service, så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

title: Marketing & Community Specialist
description:
Marketing & Community Specialist til Kids-world.


Brænder du for at skabe tætte relationer til influencers og ambassadører?

Har du styr på detaljerne, når der skal planlægges digitale events, og elsker du at engagere dig med et stærkt forældre-community?

Så er du måske vores nye Marketing & Community Specialist.


Hos Kids-world har vi fart på vores internationale vækst. Vores aktiverings- og community-indsatser er virksomhedens tillidsmotor, der opbygger relationer, arrangerer eventbaserede digitale formater og skaber lokal forankring på tværs af vores markeder.


Vi søger nu en struktureret, idérig og udadvendt medarbejder, der skal være med til at opbygge og løfte dette område som en nøglespiller i vores marketingafdeling.


Din hverdag og primære arbejdsopgaver
Du bliver den eksekverende drivkraft i vores aktiverings-indsatser. Din dag vil være fyldt med varierede opgaver, hvor du både er i direkte dialog med vores ambassadører og sikrer praktisk fremdrift på vores kampagner og digitale events.


Dine primære opgaver bliver:

·         Ambassadører & Influencer Management: Du står for den daglige kontakt med vores ambassadør- og influencer-netværk – fra indledende dialog og aftaleindgåelse til produktudsendelser og opfølgning på indhold.

·         Community Building & Giveaways: Du skal aktivt opbygge brandloyale følgere og forældre-communities, og du koordinerer og eksekverer vores løbende giveaways, konkurrencer m.m.

·         Events, Podcasts & POS-materialer: Du hjælper med det praktiske arbejde omkring deltagelse i events/messer, opsætning af podcast-aftaler og bestilling/distribution af flyers og fysiske POS-materialer til vores pakker.

·         Koordinering med Country Managers: Du understøtter vores lokale Country Managers med koordinering af lokalt tilpasset indhold og kampagnemateriale på vores internationale markeder.

 

Din placering i teamet
Du bliver en central del af et passioneret og dynamisk marketing-team. Du refererer til CMO/Head of Marketing, hvor I sammen sikrer en stærk synergi mellem ambassadører, UGC, events og vores samlede SoMe-distribution.
Du arbejder samtidig tæt sammen med vores SoMe samt vores Onsite Performance Team (omkring afvikling på shoppen).


Hvem er du?
Det vigtigste er din energi, din struktur og din lyst til at tage ejerskab over dine opgaver. Om du er nyuddannet med den rette profil, eller har et par års erfaring fra et bureau, et brand eller en
e-commerce virksomhed, er ikke afgørende.

 

Vi forestiller os, at:

·         Du er udadvendt og en stærk relationsbygger: Du elsker at skrive og tale med mennesker, og du møder altid influencers, partnere og kunder med overskud og smil.

·         Du er velstruktureret og får tingene over målstregen: Du kan holde styr på mange ambassadøraftaler, pakkeudsendelser og event-køreplaner på samme tid uden at miste overblikket.

·         Du har interesse for børnefamilie-segmentet: Du forstår forældres behov, og du ved, hvad der skaber tillid og engagement i målgruppen.

·         Du er selvkørende og løsningsorienteret: Når der opstår uforudsete udfordringer under et live-show eller et event, bevarer du roen og finder en hurtig løsning.

·         Du kan tale og forstå dansk.

 

Hvad tilbyder vi?

·         En spændende og afvekslende stilling i en af Danmarks førende e-commerce virksomheder i stærk vækst.

·         Masser af ansvar fra dag ét og rig mulighed for at præge dine egne opgaver og udvikle dig fagligt i takt med at afdelingen vokser.

·         Et uformelt, ungt og engageret arbejdsmiljø i Esbjerg med højt til loftet og stærkt sammenhold.

·         Løn efter kvalifikationer samt gode personalegoder.

 

Ansøgning og kontakt
Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning via job@kids-world.dk . Marker mailen med ” Marketing & Community Specialist”. Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

Vil du høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Dennis på 60211280 for en fortrolig samtale.

title: Leder til den selvejende institution Børnehuset Bavnehøj, København SV, søges
description:
Er du en leder med masser af medmenneskelighed og som brænder for at gå forrest, når det handler om at skabe de bedste rammer for børns dannelse og udvikling? Kan du se mulighederne i et stort hus med 102 børn og 28 ansatte? Og vil du støtte op om at skabe de bedste rammer som emmer af overskud, tryghed og ro? Har du erfaring med et godt forældresamarbejde, som afspejler trygge forældre, vil du være med til at give de bedste arbejdsvilkår for personalet og vil du have indflydelse på at børnene kan få et godt børneliv? Så har vi jobbet til dig. Vi søger nemlig en leder her til Børnehuset Bavnehøj, da vores nuværende dygtige og erfarne leder er gået på pension.

Vi tilbyder ansættelse i vores velfungerende selvejende institution, som er fyldt med skønne børn og selvstændige og engagerende ansatte, hvor din nærmeste sparringspartner vil være vores souschef som også er ressourcepædagog og Marte Meo terapeut.

Vi er en personalegruppe som har et højt ambitionsniveau og som brænder for vores arbejde omkring børns udvikling og trivsel, og gerne tager ansvar og har et godt overblik. Vi arbejder ud fra læreplanstemaerne i Københavns kommune, og det gode børnesyn samt den daglige refleksion gennem Marte Meo principperne. I både børnehavegrupperne og vuggestuegrupperne sætter vi højt, at arbejde i mindre grupper med planlagte ugentlige aktiviteter også på tværs af grupperne. Og vores grundlæggende værdier er inkluderende børnefællesskaber og anerkendelse.

Du får som leder af vores selvejende institution, under paraplyorganisationen fobu og forældrebestyrelsen, ansvaret for den daglige drift, samtidig skal du kunne omsætte forældrebestyrelsens forslag til praksis, så det stemmer overens med vores kerneopgavers værdigrundlag og vores pædagogiske læreplaner.

Vi forventer at du som leder:

· Kan lede en personalegruppe som rummer en stor mangfoldighed med mange forskellige kompetencer, har tillid til medarbejdernes faglighed og giver dem ansvar og handlefrihed i den daglige pædagogiske praksis, samt kan fordele ansvar og gå forrest når der skal tages beslutninger.

· Møder den eksisterende kultur med respekt og bygger videre på de mange styrker og gode traditioner, der allerede kendetegner arbejdspladsen, samtidig med at kunne tage det primære ansvar for fortsat udvikling af et godt inkluderende læringsmiljø med udgangspunkt i børnenes trivsel, ved at være en god vejleder, sparringspartner og rollemodel for børn og personale i hverdagen.

· Kan lytte og være anerkendende og nærværende og har en god fornemmelse for at skabe ro, sammenhold og fælles retning blandt medarbejderne.

· Har blik for hver enkelt medarbejders særlige kompetencer og herudfra støtter op omkring medarbejderens faglige udvikling og trivsel

· Vælger samt mestrer et godt forældresamarbejde med engagement og interesse

· Har interesse i at tage aktiv del i og være nysgerrig på, hvad der rør sig i lokalområdet

· Deltage aktivt i det selvejende ledernetværk net 3 i bydelen Vesterbro/Kongens Enghave.

Så hvis du tænker, at det er lige noget for dig eller du bliver nysgerrig på at høre mere om os, er du velkommen til at ringe for at aftale et besøg, vi opfordrer nemlig til et personligt fremmøde inden du sender din ansøgning. Her vil Ressourcepædagog og souschef Joan, med glæde vise dig rundt i vores hus.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 1.9.2026 kl. 12.00 og første runde af ansættelsessamtalerne foregår i 2. uge af september og med opstart pr. 16. nov. 2026

Yderligere kan vi informere om, at dine løn og ansættelsesforhold er efter gældende overenskomst med BUPL i Københavns kommune, og der forventes, at hvis man ikke har en diplomuddannelse i ledelse, at man skal tage den indenfor de første 3 år, når man bliver leder.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig her i Børnehuset Bavnehøj, Tranehavevej 15, 2450 København SV., mail: j98t@kk.dk, tlf.: 33663801/21901557

· Vedligehold og klargøring af maskiner

Vi forventer, at du:
· Er mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst
· Er god til mennesker og trives med kundekontakt
· Kan arbejde selvstændigt

· Fuldtidsstilling med frihed under ansvar

· Grundig oplæring

Lyder dette som noget for dig, så tøv ikke med at sende din ansøgning.

Du er også velkommen til at ringe og høre mere om stillingen. Se oplysninger nedenfor.

title: Social -og Sundhedsassistent med relationelle kompetencer søges til Nørregadehus
description:
På Nørregadehus søger vi to nye kollegaer fra 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest muligt, som vil være med til at skabe en meningsfuld og tryg hverdag for borgerne. 

Da vi har været i gang med at kvalitetsløfte og sikre den sundhedsfaglige indsats på vores botilbud, søger vi nye SSA-kollegaer, der sammen med vores øvrige sundhedsfaglige og pædagogiske kollegaer vil være med til fortsat at udvikle samarbejdet og kerneopgaven. 

Timetallet kan være 30-35 timer i ugen med skiftende vagter og hver anden weekend. Huset har faste nattevagter, så timerne vil være mellem klokken 7 og 23 

Nørregadehus er et af Vejen Kommunes tilbud til voksne personer med betydelig nedsat fysisk- og psykisk funktionsevne, som har behov for pædagogisk, praktisk og sundhedsfaglig støtte i hverdagen. I Nørregadehus bor der 25 borgere i egne lejligheder. 

Det er vigtigt at du kan se dig selv arbejde relationelt og pædagogisk med borgernes individuelle mål og behov, såvel som med den sundhedsfaglige indsats. 

I Nørregadehus arbejder vi tværfagligt hvilket betyder at den sundhedsfaglige indsats ikke kan stå alene. Dit arbejde med plejen og omsorgen for borgeren, skal ses som en del af indsatsen, og derfor er kollegial sparring også en stor del af hverdagen. 

Vi ønsker os kollegaer der:

  • har faglige og personlige kompetencer, til at indgå i et arbejdsfællesskab
  • har lysten til at arbejde med kvalitetssikring af de sundhedsfaglige indsatser 
  • har erfaring indenfor området 
  • har kendskab til Nexus
  • Brænder for at nedbryde ulighed i sundhed og ønsker at bidrage til sundhedsindsatser af høj kvalitet.
  • Besidder evnen til at arbejde relationelt og tværfagligt 
  • Besidder evnen til at observere og vurdere ændringer i borgernes tilstand
  • har gode kommunikative evner 
  • er fleksibel og mødestabil

 

vi kan tilbyde: 

  • en arbejdsplads i udvikling, hvor der er fokus på trivsel
  • løbende faglig sparring med mulighed for efteruddannelse af relevante kompetencer 
  • et arbejdsfællesskab hvor der er fokus på kerneopgaven 
  •  tværfagligt samarbejde med bl.a. koordinerende sygeplejerske, tværgående sygeplejerske, hjemmeplejen, pårørende, sagsbehandlere, pædagogisk personale og mange flere. 
  • Kollegaer der er anerkendende og tydelige i deres forventninger til hinanden. 
  • En hverdag med skiftende opgaver 

 

Sidste ansøgningsfrist er 25.august 2026 kl. 12.00. ansættelsessamtalerne forventes at blive afholdt 28.august 2026

Ved ansættelsen vil der blive indhentede straffeattest 

Spørgsmål ang. jobbet kan rettes til afdelingsleder Tina Overgaard Christensen på telefon 29244197 eller mail: tinao@Vejen.dk

title: Postdoc in clinical Raman spectroscopy and AI-based diagnostics
description:
A position as Postdoc (full-time) is vacant at the TE Andersen Lab part of the Research Unit of Clinical Microbiology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Shape the future of clinical diagnostics

We are seeking an ambitious and highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to help establish next-generation Raman spectroscopy technologies for clinical microbiology. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the interface between optics, artificial intelligence, microbiology and clinical diagnostics in close collaboration with hospitals, industry and international research partners.

Research environment

The successful candidate will join the research group led by Professor Thomas Emil Andersen. The group conducts translational research in microbiology, advanced infection models, spectroscopy and medical technology. We collaborate extensively with Danish and international hospitals, universities and industrial partners, with a strong focus on translating innovative technologies into improved patient care.

The academic position

The job involves research, professional development, research education, research-based teaching, and supervision.

Your responsibilities will consist of the following:

  • Lead OUH contributions to the EU- and state-funded projects (Innovation Fund Denmark project nanoRaman, two Eurostars projects MbCare and QMIC, and the MedTech Odense project UriNix).

  • Design, plan and execute experimental studies from concept to publication.

  • Develop Raman spectroscopy workflows for analysis of clinical samples.

  • Apply machine learning and AI for spectral analysis and diagnostic classification.

  • Coordinate collaborations across hospitals, academia and industrial partners.

  • Build and develop a Raman spectroscopy research platform within the Andersen Lab.

  • Supervise students and junior researchers.

  • Publishing results in leading international journals and contributing to future grant applications.

Expectations and qualifications

We are looking for candidates holding a PhD in physics, engineering, optics, spectroscopy, biomedical engineering or a related discipline. The candidate may also hold a PhD within health sciences, biology, microbiology or similar but should then also hold significant knowledge and experience within optical sciences, spectroscopy and related data handling.

Essential qualifications:

  • Significant knowledge and experience with Raman spectroscopy.

  • Experience with optical instrumentation.

  • Experience with machine learning and/or AI.

  • Experience analysing biological or clinical samples.

  • Profound in scientific writing and a solid publication record.

Desirable qualifications:

  • Experience with clinical microbiology or hospital diagnostics.

  • Experience in academia–industry collaborations.

  • Project coordination skills.

  • Ability to work independently while thriving in multidisciplinary teams.

What we offer

  • A unique translational research environment combining engineering and medicine.

  • Participation in major externally funded collaborative projects.

  • Close interaction with clinicians, engineers and industrial partners.

  • Access to state-of-the-art spectroscopy and microbiology facilities.

  • Excellent opportunities for scientific publishing, networking and career development.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision - We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future - it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research - with people at the centre; strong research environments - as drivers of development; and the research journey - from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information

Further information about the position can be obtained from Professor Thomas Emil Andersen, e-mail: thandersen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 21261634 or Head of Department of Clinical Research, Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477.

Application deadline

August 18, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at the laboratory of Professor Andersen at the Department of Clinical Microbiology, Odense University Hospital, J. B. Winsløws Vej 21.1, Odense C, Denmark. The laboratory and department will move to the newly built University Hospital associated with the University of Southern Denmark, in late summer 2027.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

  • An explanation other qualification relevant to the post

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Til vores værksteds- og lagerteam i Hasselager søger vi en der tager fat og kan svejse rustfri/ We're looking for someone to join our workshop and warehouse team in Hasselager - someone who's a go do'er and can weld stainless steel
description:
English Below.

Hos Alfotech hjælper vi hinanden. Det er ikke bare noget vi siger, det er måden vi arbejder på. Hvis du er typen der ser hvad der skal gøres og gør det uden at blive spurgt, så læs videre.

Hvem er vi

Alfotech er videnscenter for procesindustrien. Vi leverer slanger, fittings, koblinger og specialløsninger til fødevare, pharma og den kemiske industri i hele Europa. Vi har travlt, vi leverer hurtigt, og kvaliteten må ikke svigte.

Hvad du skal lave

Dit primære hjem er værkstedet og lageret under vores teamleder Peter. Du svejser i rustfrit stål når der er ordrer på det, og du er med til at samle, montere, trykprøve og klargøre løsninger fra start til slut. Du dokumenterer i vores ERP-system og svejselog.

Og så er der perioderne imellem. Her hjælper du til i pluk, modtagelse og klargøring af varer, eller der hvor holdet har brug for dig. Det er en fast del af jobbet, ikke en undtagelse.

Hvem vi leder efter

Du har erfaring med TIG-svejsning i rustfrit stål, måske som uddannet rustfri smed eller med baggrund fra et værksted hvor rustfrit var hverdagen. Det er udgangspunktet, resten lærer vi dig. Du er i fysisk god form, møder stabilt op og har en naturlig trang til at bidrage. Du er ligeglad med om opgaven den dag hedder svejsning eller varemodtagelse. Truckkort er en fordel, ellers sørger vi for det.

Arbejdstid og ansættelse

Arbejdstiden er 7 til 15, fredag kl. 14:30. Du bliver funktionæransat med fast løn. Skal du gå tidligere en dag, finder vi en løsning og du indhenter timerne.

Vi tilbyder faglig udvikling og betaler for kurser og certifikater. Fælles morgenmad hver fredag og et hold med uformel omgangstone.

English:

At Alfotech, we help each other. It’s not just something we say—it’s the way we work. If you’re the kind of person who sees what needs to be done and does it without being asked, then read on.

Who We Are

Alfotech is a knowledge center for the process industry. We supply hoses, fittings, couplings, and custom solutions to the food, pharmaceutical, and chemical industries throughout Europe. We’re busy, we deliver quickly, and quality must never be compromised.

What You’ll Be Doing

Your primary workstation will be the workshop and warehouse under the supervision of our team leader, Peter. You’ll weld stainless steel when orders come in, and you’ll help assemble, install, pressure-test, and prepare solutions from start to finish. You’ll document your work in our ERP system and welding log.

And then there are the periods in between. During these times, you’ll help with picking, receiving, and preparing goods—or wherever the team needs you. This is an integral part of the job, not an exception.

Who We’re Looking For

You have experience with TIG welding of stainless steel—perhaps as a trained stainless steel welder or with a background in a workshop where working with stainless steel was part of your daily routine. That’s the starting point; we’ll teach you the rest. You’re in good physical shape, show up consistently, and have a natural desire to contribute. You don’t mind whether the task for the day is welding or receiving goods. A forklift license is a plus; if you don’t have one, we’ll take care of it.

Work Hours and Employment

Work hours are 7 a.m. to 3 p.m., with Friday ending at 2:30 p.m. You’ll be hired as a salaried employee with a fixed salary. If you need to leave early one day, we’ll find a solution, and you’ll make up the hours.

  • Er selvkørende og ikke bange for at tage fat

Vi er en del af CRH – en international koncern – men i Roust er vi et lokalt team med stærkt sammenhold, uformel tone og fokus på sikkerhed. Vi hjælper hinanden, vi udvikler hinanden, og vi får tingene gjort.

Vi søger 1 ny kollega til vores team af florister.

Så vil du med på vores spændende rejse, hvor du arbejder fra vores nye flotte binderi i Søften ved Aarhus. 

God timeløn og du bestemmer selv dine arbejdstider, også hvis du ønsker forskellig timetal uge for uge. 

Samtidig binder vi i letter materialer, så du ikke belaster dine skulder og arme så meget. 

Vi går meget op i et godt arbejdsmiljø, så du står på absoberende måtter, har hæve/sænke arbejdsbord, og du får arbejdestøj og det bedste i værktøj.  

Vores indeklima er ikke vådt og fugtigt som du kender det fra trationelle blomsterbutikker. 

Jobbet går ud på at binde bæredygtige blomsterbuketter, som vi sælger på vores webshop og via design, indretning, brugskunst og møbelbutikker. Vi sælger i både Danmark, Sverige, Norge og Tyskland.

I vores koncept køre vi med flere forskellig buketter design i 3 størrelser. Det er disse buketter man skal binde, man arbejder i vores binderi og står sammen med søde kollegaer.

Tjek vores hjemmeside www.livingflowers.dk for lidt mere info om vores bæredygtige koncept og for at se vores buketter.

Udover buketter levere vi også mere og mere til Hoteller og restauranter, hvor vi laver speciel designs, som tilpasses kundes behov. Så ønsker du yderlig udfordring, så er der muligheder hos disse kunder. 

Det er et krav at du er blomsterbinder, blomsterdekoratør uddandelsen eller minimum har arbejdet fuldtid i nogle år som blomsterbinder.  

Vi læser ansøgningerne løbende når de kommer ind og indkalder også løbende til samtaler, så sende endlig din ansøgning med det samme.

 

ENGLISH VERSION: 

We are looking for full-time florist, we are very flexible with come and go times, we will find the best working hours for you. As we are not a store, we do not work in the weekends. 

We are located in Søften (Aarhus), and the job is to tie sustainable flower bouquets, which we sell on our webshop and via shops around Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Germany.

See more about us at : www.livingflowers.dk

It is a requirement to have a florist education or have worked with binding flowers full time for minimum 3 years.

title: CRM Manager - Retention & Loyalty - Do you want to help LAKRIDS BY BÜLOW on our mission to make the world love liquorice?
description:
Lakrids by Bülow | Copenhagen, Denmark (hybrid) - international candidates welcome | Full-time

Reports to: Head of CRM, Johanna Ternander

The Opportunity

Lakrids by Bülow has built one of the most engaged confectionery communities in the Nordics — Lakrids Lovers. The platform is growing, the data is there, and the opportunity to turn it into a genuine retention and revenue engine is significant. We are hiring a commercially minded CRM Manager to bring the strategic and analytical brain that takes Lakrids Lovers to the next level. You will own lifecycle strategy, segmentation, campaign execution and platform development, and play a key role in scaling the programme globally.

What You Will Own

CRM Strategy & Lifecycle Marketing

  • Develop and own lifecycle marketing strategies across welcome, onboarding, retention, reactivation, post-purchase and seasonal journeys

  • Own the CRM calendar and ensure alignment with GTM, commercial and seasonal priorities

  • Define the commercial CRM roadmap in partnership with Head of CRM and CGMO

Lakrids Lovers Development

  • Strengthen loyalty engagement, member value creation and community growth

  • Improve member recruitment, activation, retention and repeat purchase frequency

  • Develop referral and community-driven growth initiatives

  • Support the evolution of Lakrids Lovers as a scalable global loyalty programme

Personalisation & Segmentation

  • Build audience segmentation frameworks to improve targeting, relevance and personalisation

  • Develop strategies for high-value customer segments including gifting buyers, Champions and high LTV customers.

  • Support personalised customer experiences across email marketing, SMS marketing and future channels

Campaign Execution & Platform Ownership

  • Analyse retention, repurchase behaviour, customer lifetime value and campaign effectiveness

  • Build actionable commercial reporting and revenue attribution frameworks

  • Leverage AI-powered tools within your CRM platform (predictive send-time, AI content generation, churn prediction)

What We Are Looking For

(Please note that the listed skills are required for this role)

  • Min. 5 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, loyalty or retention marketing. We welcome candidates from consumer goods, retail, hospitality, travel or subscription businesses who bring commercial maturity and a fresh perspective

  • Proven ownership of a CRM programme or loyalty programme. Not just campaign execution within one

  • Strong commercial mindset: You think in CLV, repeat purchase rate and revenue contribution, not open rates

  • Hands-on experience with CRM platforms: Voyado, Klaviyo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze or similar

  • Data-literate: you segment, analyse and turn customer behaviour into actionable strategies

  • Comfortable working with AI tools for personalisation, segmentation and content generation

  • Experience in a brand or business where CRM is a primary revenue channel, not a support function

Fluent English. Danish, German or French a plus

What Makes You Stand Out

We are looking for candidates who bring diversity of thought and a breadth of experience. We value people who have worked across different industries, geographies or business models — and who bring a perspective that challenges how we think.

  • You have worked in hospitality, travel or subscription — industries where retention is existential and lifecycle marketing is highly sophisticated

  • You have experience scaling a loyalty programme across multiple markets with different consumer behaviours

  • You bring a perspective on community and membership that goes beyond transactional loyalty

  • You know what good looks like and how to get there

How Success Is Measured

  • Repeat purchase rate and purchase frequency

  • Customer lifetime value (CLV) growth across segments

  • Lakrids Lovers member growth, activation and retention rate

  • CRM revenue contribution and attribution

  • Retention and engagement metrics by lifecycle stage

  • Automation quality, deliverability and campaign effectiveness

How to Apply

Please attach your application & CV as pdf

Do you want to help us on our mission to make the world love liquorice?

LAKRIDS BY BÜLOW is a premium confectionery brand built on craftsmanship, quality and passion. Since 2007, we have grown from one store in Denmark to an international brand with strong retail and B2B presence across Europe.

At LAKRIDS BY BÜLOW, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equal and inclusive workplace across all markets and functions. We believe diverse perspectives strengthen our teams and our results.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role for someone who has seen how great execution is done at scale, and wants to build it from scratch at a brand with global ambitions.

Global GTM Planning

  • Lead launch readiness processes — milestones, ownership, timing and channel activation plans

Launch & Campaign Execution

(Please note that the listed skills are required for this role)

  • Min. 5 years of experience in go-to-market, trade marketing, integrated marketing or brand management — we welcome candidates from retail, hospitality, lifestyle or adjacent industries

  • Experience orchestrating multi-channel launches across retail, ecommerce and wholesale

  • Exceptional cross-functional coordination skills. You have held complex stakeholder landscapes together under pressure

  • Strong communicator who builds trust and creates clarity quickly

  • Data-literate: able to evaluate launch performance and translate it into improvements

  • Comfortable using AI tools to build launch calendars, draft briefs, synthesise performance data

  • Fluent English. Danish, German or French a plus

What Makes You Stand Out

We are looking for candidates who bring diversity of thought and a breadth of experience. We value people who have worked across different industries, geographies or business models — and who bring a perspective that challenges how we think.

  • You bring that structural thinking to a lean environment

  • You have a background in retail operations, hospitality or events. Industries where execution precision is non-negotiable

  • You have experience working across very different channels simultaneously: Luxury retail, mass wholesale and DTC, and you understand what each requires

  • You have built or designed a GTM process, not just maintained one that was working

How Success Is Measured

  • On-time GTM delivery across all launches and seasonal moments

  • Launch execution quality — sell-in readiness and channel activation completion rate

  • Seasonal readiness score across markets

  • Cross-functional execution efficiency — fewer late-stage changes and escalations

  • Campaign and launch commercial performance vs. targets

How to Apply

title: Product Manager - Do you want to help LAKRIDS BY BÜLOW on our mission to make the world love liquorice?
description:
Lakrids by Bülow | Copenhagen, Denmark (hybrid) — international candidates welcome | Full-time | Individual contributor

Reports to: Chief Growth & Marketing Officer (CGMO)

The Opportunity

Lakrids by Bülow is building its commercial product engine, and this role owns it. From innovation pipeline to launch governance, assortment architecture to gifting strategy, you will create the structures that turn great products into consistent commercial wins. If you have built product lifecycle processes at a premium consumer brand and want genuine ownership from day one, we want to hear from you.

What You Will Own

Product Lifecycle Management

  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from concept brief to discontinuation across all categories

  • Build and maintain stage-gate governance, launch readiness frameworks and critical path planning

  • Coordinate timelines across innovation, supply chain, packaging, sales and marketing

  • Ensure on-time, on-brief launches across all markets and channels

Portfolio & Assortment Management

  • Develop a scalable global assortment architecture: core, seasonal, gifting and market-specific

  • Drive SKU productivity analysis, portfolio rationalisation and complexity reduction

  • Define and own the gifting architecture as a strategic and growing revenue pillar

  • Support range planning for new product development and innovation pipeline governance

Pricing & Commercial Strategy

  • Support global pricing architecture and cross-market pricing consistency

  • Build commercial business cases and launch P&Ls in partnership with Finance

  • Analyse assortment profitability, hero SKU contribution and margin mix

  • Partner with Sales on sell-in readiness and commercial launch forecasting

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as the connective tissue between Innovation, Supply Chain, Sales, Marketing, Ecommerce and CRM

  • Establish scalable ways of working and shared launch processes across the business

  • Capture and systematically implement learnings from each launch cycle

  • Use AI tools to accelerate data analysis, scenario modelling, launch reporting and portfolio planning

What We Are Looking For

(Please note that the listed skills are required for this role)

  • Min. 5 years of experience in product management, brand management or product marketing — we welcome candidates from both consumer goods and adjacent industries who bring a fresh perspective

  • Proven ownership of product launch processes end-to-end — from brief to shelf to post-launch review

  • Strong commercial acumen: P&L literacy, pricing logic, assortment and range planning thinking

  • Experience building or significantly improving launch governance or stage-gate processes

  • Highly structured and process-driven without being bureaucratic; you simplify, not complicate

  • International experience or exposure across European or global markets

  • Fluent English; additional languages a plus

What Makes You Stand Out

We are looking for candidates who bring diversity of thought and a breadth of experience. We value people who have worked across different industries, geographies or business models — and who bring a perspective that challenges how we think.

  • You have worked across more than one industry or business model — retail, DTC, wholesale, B2B — and you bring that breadth to how you think about product

  • You have experience in categories beyond food — lifestyle, beauty, home, fashion — where product storytelling and commercial discipline coexist

  • You have worked in both large structured organisations and leaner scale-ups, and you know how to operate in both

  • You have a track record of challenging the status quo on assortment complexity — and winning the argument commercially

How Success Is Measured

  • On-time and on-brief launch rate across all categories

  • SKU productivity and portfolio gross margin improvement

  • Launch sell-through performance vs. forecast

  • Reduction in late-stage launch changes and operational complexity

  • Pricing consistency across markets and channels

title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

title: Postdoc in clinical Raman spectroscopy and AI-based diagnostics
description:
A position as Postdoc (full-time) is vacant at the TE Andersen Lab part of the Research Unit of Clinical Microbiology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Shape the future of clinical diagnostics

We are seeking an ambitious and highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to help establish next-generation Raman spectroscopy technologies for clinical microbiology. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the interface between optics, artificial intelligence, microbiology and clinical diagnostics in close collaboration with hospitals, industry and international research partners.

Research environment

The successful candidate will join the research group led by Professor Thomas Emil Andersen. The group conducts translational research in microbiology, advanced infection models, spectroscopy and medical technology. We collaborate extensively with Danish and international hospitals, universities and industrial partners, with a strong focus on translating innovative technologies into improved patient care.

The academic position

The job involves research, professional development, research education, research-based teaching, and supervision.

Your responsibilities will consist of the following:

  • Lead OUH contributions to the EU- and state-funded projects (Innovation Fund Denmark project nanoRaman, two Eurostars projects MbCare and QMIC, and the MedTech Odense project UriNix).

  • Design, plan and execute experimental studies from concept to publication.

  • Develop Raman spectroscopy workflows for analysis of clinical samples.

  • Apply machine learning and AI for spectral analysis and diagnostic classification.

  • Coordinate collaborations across hospitals, academia and industrial partners.

  • Build and develop a Raman spectroscopy research platform within the Andersen Lab.

  • Supervise students and junior researchers.

  • Publishing results in leading international journals and contributing to future grant applications.

Expectations and qualifications

We are looking for candidates holding a PhD in physics, engineering, optics, spectroscopy, biomedical engineering or a related discipline. The candidate may also hold a PhD within health sciences, biology, microbiology or similar but should then also hold significant knowledge and experience within optical sciences, spectroscopy and related data handling.

Essential qualifications:

  • Significant knowledge and experience with Raman spectroscopy.

  • Experience with optical instrumentation.

  • Experience with machine learning and/or AI.

  • Experience analysing biological or clinical samples.

  • Profound in scientific writing and a solid publication record.

Desirable qualifications:

  • Experience with clinical microbiology or hospital diagnostics.

  • Experience in academia–industry collaborations.

  • Project coordination skills.

  • Ability to work independently while thriving in multidisciplinary teams.

What we offer

  • A unique translational research environment combining engineering and medicine.

  • Participation in major externally funded collaborative projects.

  • Close interaction with clinicians, engineers and industrial partners.

  • Access to state-of-the-art spectroscopy and microbiology facilities.

  • Excellent opportunities for scientific publishing, networking and career development.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision - We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future - it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research - with people at the centre; strong research environments - as drivers of development; and the research journey - from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information

Further information about the position can be obtained from Professor Thomas Emil Andersen, e-mail: thandersen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 21261634 or Head of Department of Clinical Research, Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477.

Application deadline

August 18, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at the laboratory of Professor Andersen at the Department of Clinical Microbiology, Odense University Hospital, J. B. Winsløws Vej 21.1, Odense C, Denmark. The laboratory and department will move to the newly built University Hospital associated with the University of Southern Denmark, in late summer 2027.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

  • An explanation other qualification relevant to the post

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

Our cafe Tinyhus serves continental food, also traditional local cuisines for events and catering. 

We strive to provide authentic food and exceptional service to our guests and we look for team members who are self-motivated, proactive and passionate to walk the extra mile to provide exceptional culinery experience for our guests.

title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project: The Molecular Endocrinology Department (KMEB), Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD scholarship
description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project:

The Molecular Endocrinology Department (KMEB), Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD scholarship for a highly motivated candidate interested in working at the intersection of cancer biology and endocrinology. The project aims to investigate stanniocalcin-2 (STC2) as a key mediator of adipose tissue–tumor crosstalk in obesity-related cancer.

The project is part of a larger collaborative research initiative, the Molecular Mechanisms Linking Obesity and Cancer (MMLOC) network, funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. Though this grant, 2/3 of the PhD salary has been secured.

Employment is therefore conditional upon the successful enrolment of the candidate as a PhD student at the PhD School at Faculty of Health Sciences, and the awarding of a one-year Faculty Scholarship. 

 

Research environment

The PhD project will be anchored at KMEB, a research unit focused on clinical and translational endocrinology, under the supervision of Associate Professor Rikke Hjortebjerg and Professor Jan Frystyk. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with the laboratory of co-supervisor Professor Henrik Ditzel, Cancer and Inflammation Research Unit, Department of Molecular Medicine, SDU. 

The candidate will work across two complementary research groups with access to state-of-the-art research facilities. Together, the groups provide a multidisciplinary research environment with close integration of clinical and experimental research. The teams are internationally oriented and offer a supportive and inclusive research culture.

You can read more about KMEB here: https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/kmeb

 

Project description

Our research centers around the insulin-like growth factor (IGF) system, a key hormonal regulator in several diseases. The project focuses on stanniocalcin-2 (STC2), an IGF system member that is linked to poor outcomes in most obesity-related cancers but paradoxically predicts favorable prognosis in postmenopausal estrogen receptor-positive (ER+) breast cancer. 

The aim is to examine how STC2 effects are modulated by obesity and estrogen signaling and how it regulates IGF-2/insulin receptor pathways in the tumor–adipose microenvironment. To establish clinically relevant models, the candidate will generate patient-derived xenograft (PDX) mouse models with human tumor tissue and participate in establishing patient-derived organoids and 3D co-cultures. These systems will be interrogated using genetically engineered STC2 and PAPP-A variants and analyzed with advanced sequencing, spatial, and single-cell omics.

The PhD student will:

  • Establish and analyze PDX mouse models of ER+ breast cancer.

  • Sample and process tumor and tumor-adjacent/distant adipose tissue from breast cancer patients.

  • Assess STC2 activity, IGF-2 signaling, and tumor growth under estrogen-controlled conditions.

  • Help analyze molecular data generated through sequencing and omics-based approaches.

 

Qualifications

The applicant should possess the following qualifications:

  • A master’s degree (MSc or equivalent) in molecular biology, biomedicine, or related fields. 

  • Preferably prior experience with endocrinology or cancer research. 

  • An interest in working with animal models (mice) is a necessity.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

  • A motivated, independent, and quality-oriented approach to research, with enthusiasm for learning new scientific disciplines and methodologies.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:
Rikke Hjortebjerg

KMEB, Department of Clinical Research

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

E-mail: rhjortebjerg@health.sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• At letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)


Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. This also applies to reference letters.

 

Closing date September 1, 2026

Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order)

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.
