title: Director - Client Service & Product Architecture (f/m/d)
description:
Director - Client Service & Product Architecture (f/m/d)

Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work:

We are seeking an experienced and client-focused Head of Client Service & Product Architecture to lead and scale our client-facing service organization for our next-generation fund-distribution market infrastructure, built on blockchain, cloud-native, and microservice technologies.
This role is responsible for defining the client-service strategy, ensuring operational excellence, and delivering an outstanding service experience for our institutional customers. As the voice of the client within the organization, this leader will influence Clients' experience, lead service reviews, oversee incident management, and ensure that every client receives timely, accurate, and proactive support.
The ideal candidate combines service leadership, operational discipline, and strong knowledge of financial industry workflows, with the ability to build trust with clients and internal teams alike.

Your responsibilities:

Client Service Strategy & Leadership

• Define and execute the end-to-end client service strategy, covering support, incident response, and ongoing day to day client interactions.
• Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing client service team supporting institutional clients across multiple regions.
• Establish client-centric KPIs, quality standards, and SLAs aligned with business objectives and regulatory expectations.
• Promote a strong client-success culture across the company.

Operational Support & Issue Resolution

• Lead the day-to-day operations of the Client Service function, ensuring timely response to client requests, tickets, and escalations.
• Oversee incident management, root-cause analysis, and communication for service disruptions or critical issues.
• Implement continuous improvement initiatives based on metrics, trends, and post-incident reviews.
• Ensure all support processes adhere to security, data protection, and operational risk standards.

Client Relationship & Communication

• Act as a senior point of escalation for key clients, building trust through transparency, accountability, and proactive engagement.
• Conduct regular service reviews with major clients to discuss performance, roadmap updates, and improvement opportunities.
• Provide clear communication on product changes, maintenance schedules, and operational impacts.

Collaboration & Cross-Functional Influence

• Work closely with Product Engineering, QA, Compliance, and Clearstream teams to relay client feedback and ensure alignment on support priorities.
• Influence product roadmap decisions by systematically capturing client needs, pain points, and usage patterns.
• Support regulatory and audit requirements relating to service quality, operational resilience, and client communications.

Tools, Processes & Governance

• Select and manage customer support tools, ticketing systems, dashboards, and monitoring solutions.
• Define standard operating procedures (SOPs), support guidelines, and escalation paths.
• Ensure accurate and up-to-date documentation for clients and internal teams (knowledge base, runbooks, FAQs).
• Support audit readiness and compliance checks related to client service operations.

Your profile:

• Leadership & Experience: 8–12+ years of experience in client service or customer success, including several years of experience building, scaling, and leading teams.
• Industry Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of fintech, financial services, or regulated environments, with preferred knowledge of Transfer Agency, fund distribution, or market infrastructure.
• Technical Aptitude: Familiarity with cloud-native platforms, APIs, microservices, and complex integration-driven products; exposure to blockchain/DLT is a strong asset.
• Institutional Client Management: Proven ability to manage institutional clients, build strong relationships, and successfully resolve complex technical escalations.
• Operational Excellence: A data-driven, problem-solving mindset with experience managing KPIs, SLAs, and incident-management processes in critical environments.
• Collaboration & Onboarding: Strong project-management skills to coordinate client onboarding and collaborate effectively with cross-functional product and engineering teams.
• Adaptability & Communication: Exceptional communication and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth, and regulated environment.

title: Team Lead Client Success Management (f/m/d)
description:
Team Lead Client Success Management (f/m/d)

Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work:

We are seeking an experienced Head of Client Success Management to lead our client-facing solution design and project delivery organization. You will be at the helm of our next-generation fund-distribution market infrastructure, built on blockchain, cloud-native, and microservice technologies.

This strategic leadership role is responsible for defining the end-to-end client implementation strategy, from initial solution architecture to successful onboarding and go-live. You will lead and mentor a high-performing team composed of Client Solution Managers—our Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) who design tailored client solutions—and Client Project Managers who execute and deliver these initiatives.

As the leader of this critical function, you will ensure that client requirements are expertly captured, translated into scalable solutions, and delivered flawlessly. The ideal candidate combines deep financial industry knowledge, strong leadership acumen, and a proven track-to-record in managing complex, technology-driven client projects in a regulated environment.

Your responsibilities:

Strategy & Leadership

• Define and execute the comprehensive strategy for client solution design, project management, and onboarding, ensuring alignment with business objectives and product roadmaps.
• Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing organization of Client Solution Managers (SMEs) and Client Project Managers, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and client-centricity.
• Establish and govern the KPIs, quality standards, and methodologies for the entire client implementation lifecycle, from scoping and SoW creation to project delivery and handover to Client Service.
• Act as the senior-most point of contact for strategic client escalations related to solution design and project delivery, building trust through transparency and effective leadership.

Solution Design & Governance

• Oversee the Client Solution Management function, reinforcing their role as Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in translating complex client needs into robust, scalable target operating models.
• Govern the solution design process, ensuring that all client proposals and Statements of Work (SoWs) are aligned with platform capabilities, product strategy, and delivery capacity.
• Empower Client Solution Managers (SMEs) to advise clients on best practices for adopting our platform, ensuring long-term value and client success.

Project & Onboarding Delivery Oversight

• Lead the Client Project Management function, ensuring the consistent and successful delivery of all client onboarding and implementation projects.
• Standardize and optimize the project management framework, including planning, risk management (RAID), resource allocation, and reporting, to ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Ensure seamless coordination across internal teams (Product, Engineering, QA, Client Service) to align all delivery activities with client expectations.

Cross-Functional Influence & Collaboration

• Partner closely with the Heads of Product Engineering, and Client Service to ensure a cohesive, end-to-end client journey.
• Influence the product roadmap by systematically consolidating and relaying client requirements, strategic opportunities, and feedback gathered during the solutioning and delivery process.
• Collaborate with Sales and Business Development to provide expert guidance during RFPs, pre-sales discussions, and commercial scoping.

Your profile:

• Leadership & Experience: 10–15+ years in client-facing roles (implementation, consulting, or services) with 5+ years of experience leading, motivating, and scaling technical teams.
• Domain Expertise: Deep background in FinTech, capital markets, fund distribution, transfer agency, or highly regulated financial-workflow environments.
• Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with API-driven integrations, data migration, cloud-native platforms, and microservices.
• Portfolio & Project Management: Proven history of managing portfolios of complex, concurrent projects for institutional clients, utilizing Agile delivery methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence).
• Dual Design & Delivery Focus: Demonstrated capability to oversee both technical solution architecture and end-to-end project management.
• Strategic & Data-Driven Mindset: Ability to translate high-level business goals into delivery plans, using data to drive operational efficiency and quality assurance.
• Executive Stakeholder Collaboration: Exceptional communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills, with a track record of partnering with cross-functional executives (Product, Engineering, Sales, Compliance).

description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As a Talent Acquisition Partner (f/m/d), you will support recruiting activities for Gas Services while partnering closely with business leaders, HR Business Partners, and a global Talent Acquisition network. Beyond leading day-to-day recruiting operations, you will drive recruiting projects, mentor recruiters, and continuously improve recruiting efficiency and delivery. This role offers a long-term career path with the opportunity to grow into a broader Talent Acquisition leadership position within Gas Services as organizational responsibilities evolve.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Strategic partnership with business leaders and hiring managers across a complex global matrix organization to develop and execute recruiting strategies aligned with business priorities
* Operational leadership and coaching of project teams, ensuring effective workload allocation, capacity planning, prioritization, and delivery against KPIs and service level expectations
* Leadership of Talent Acquisition projects and support of organizational transformation and continuous improvement initiatives across the global Talent Acquisition organization
* Analysis of recruiting metrics and market insights to identify optimization opportunities and drive data-informed decisions that enhance recruiting effectiveness and process excellence
* End-to-end management of recruiting activities across a broad range of functions and position levels, including both tariff and non-tariff roles, while ensuring an outstanding candidate and hiring manager experience
* Close collaboration with HR, Works Councils, business leaders, and global stakeholders to provide guidance on recruiting processes, governance, labor relations, and talent acquisition strategies

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field
* Extensive Talent Acquisition experience with a strong end-to-end recruiting generalist background, ideally gained within a global industrial or corporate environment

title: Research Associate (PhD Student) (m/f/d) in Computational Biology / Bioinformatics (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
description:
...you're in the middle of it

Our **Department of Nephrology **and the Else Kroener-Fresenius-Center (EKFZ) provide excellent, state-of-the-art facilities to conduct interdisciplinary and computational research at the intersection of nephrology, immunology, and cardiovascular biology. We offer an attractive, supportive environment for modern science in molecular medicine and systems biology. We are looking for an ambitious, talented and highly motivated candidate to join our team.

The project that you are working on is embedded in a translational research program aiming to understand how the hematopoietic system crosslinks interactions between aging, cardiovascular, and kidney diseases. You will integrate multi-omic datasets to investigate molecular and cellular mechanisms in various organs and immune cells. By bridging single-cell resolution with global biobank scales, your work will help identify novel molecular mechanisms and therapeutic targets.

The candidate will be supervised and supported by experienced computational biologists, molecular biologists and clinicians. The project is designed to perform cutting-edge research with state-of-the-art methods and technologies.

Your Role:

- Analyze and integrate in-house and publicly available single-cell RNA-seq, single-cell ATAC-seq, and CITE-seq datasets
- Analyze large-scale genomic, proteomic and clinical data from the UK Biobank (UKB) and All of Us Research Program
- Develop and implement reproducible and scalable computational pipelines and workflows
- Collaborate closely with experimental biologists and clinicians in an interdisciplinary environment to define hypotheses and interpret results in a biological and clinical context
- Present research findings within the working group and at international conferences and publish in peer-reviewed journals and cumulate your findings in a doctoral thesis

... your skills are what we're looking for

- Master’s degree (or equivalent) in computational or molecular biology, bioinformatics, molecular medicine or a related field
- Proficiency in either R or Python for data analysis, statistics, and visualization.
- Previous experience with bioinformatic analysis of single-cell RNAseq analysis (Seurat/Scanpy) and/or genetic data
- A solid foundational understanding of molecular biology, genetics, or immunology, and a keen interest in human disease mechanisms.
- Keen interest in leveraging omics to elucidate disease mechanisms in cardiovascular and/or kidney disease and immunology
- Previous experience with reproducible coding practices and working in cloud environments is a plus.
- Solid understanding of statistics
- Willingness to understand and apply state-of-the-art computational tools and algorithms for single-cell, multi-omics and genetic analysis
- Very good verbal and written skills in English; German is an advantage but not required
- High motivation, ability to work independently as well as in an interdisciplinary team, excellent organizational and communication skills
- Due to legal regulations, valid proof of measles immunity / measles vaccination is required.

... you'll be offered a lot

- In addition to an attractive salary based on acollective agreement with an annual special payment, you benefit from long-term security through company pension schemes
- Internal and external training for your professional development
- Benefit from our attractive health offers. We offer regular online and face-to-face courses on nutrition, relaxation, sports and exercise
- We offer childcare in our daycare center (if you have any questions, please contact UKF-Familienservice), child care during holidays
- Free public transport in all Hessen (Free State Ticket Hessen)
- Uniklinik-Campus, Mensa, Cafés
- Insights: Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn
- FAQ´s for new employees

**It's time to join our team! **

Kontakt: Dr. Simone-Franziska Glaser, Head of Research of the Else Kroener-Fresenius-Center
Mail: glaser@med.uni-frankfurt.de** **

title: PostDoc - Deep time organic biomarker analytics expert(m/f/d) (Biologe/Biologin)
description:
Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre (SBiK-F), starting as soon as possible:

Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) - Deep time organic biomarker analytics expert

(part time)

Location: Frankfurt
Employment scope: part time (75 %)
Type of contract: temporary, limited to 2 years
Remuneration: collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E13

The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.

The mission of the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre is to study the complex interactions between biodiversity and climate change.

We are looking for an organic biomarker expert with proven experience in deep time paleoclimate research. We strive to explore material from UNESCO World Heritage sites and experience in handling material from such environments is desired. One key goal of the position is to contribute to the reconstruction of highly-resolved deep-time paleoclimate records in Central Europe during a key climate interval of the Paleogene.

Your tasks

- Using state-of-the-art biomarker analytics to develop a paleoclimatic framework within a highly-resolved deep-time paleoclimate archive
- Contribute to refinement of biomarker proxy applications
- General contributions to laboratory development
- Collaborate with geologists and paleobiologists in the team to establish interrelationships between climatic change and paleo biological diversity

Your profile

- Doctoral degree in Earth Sciences with particular focus on organic biomarker geochemistry in deep time paleoclimate archives
- Profound and documented experience in stable isotope geochemistry and biomarker analysis.
- Expertise in data analysis and willingness to collaborate closely with colleagues in paleobiology, paleoclimate research and Earth surface processes
- Proven ability to publish biomarker geochemistry data in scientific journals with highest scientific standards
- Profound experience in organic geochemical laboratory work
- Excellent written and oral communication skills in German and English

Desirable skills

- Research experience in interdisciplinary working environments

We offer

- Opportunity to work closely with leading experts in Earth System Research as well as paleoenvironmental reconstructions﻿
- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations
- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution
- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension plan

Senckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.

How to apply?

Please upload your application (letter of motivation with a short description of your previous and current research foci, a CV, certificates of academic achievements, list of publications as well as letter(s) of recommendation, if available) (as a single PDF) by 24.08.2026.

Contact

Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung
Senckenberganlage 25
60325 Frankfurt am Main

For specific questions about this role, please contact Prof. Dr. Andreas Mulch at andreas.mulch@senckenberg.de

For data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/

Please visit our website at www.senckenberg.de for further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung.

We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Senior Data Engineer to help build the next-generation data foundation for fraud prevention.

Be part of building the financial backbone of Delivery Hero. You’ll develop products that empower millions of customers and merchants, from seamless payments to innovative financial solutions like wallets and credit. Your work will support our path to profitability by creating financial flexibility for users and enabling smooth transactions across our markets.

Our Flink-based streaming platform already powers real-time fraud signals. In this role, you will build and enhance historization capabilities, batch pipelines, data quality framework, and observability tooling to make fraud data reliable, traceable, and easy to use for rule evaluation, model training, inference, and backtesting.

You will work closely with Data Science and Engineering teams and own the full lifecycle of these data solutions, from design and development to operation and continuous improvement.

- Build accurate, point-in-time-correct datasets for model training, backtesting, and analysis.
- Design and build scalable batch pipelines that complement our existing Flink-based streaming platform.
- Develop robust controls for data completeness, freshness, anomaly detection, reconciliation, and business-logic accuracy.
- Build observability capabilities that surface pipeline failures, data drift, and quality issues before they affect downstream models or fraud rules.
- Partner with Data Scientists and Fraud Ops to translate fraud-prevention use cases into scalable, resilient data products while maintaining consistency between batch and real-time processing.

Qualifications

**Cloud Data Engineering: experience building production data pipelines using Python, Airflow, dbt, and BigQuery on GCP or AWS.

- Stream Processing: hands-on experience with Apache Flink or a similar framework, including event time, state, checkpointing, and late-arriving data.
- **Data Science Enablement: a strong understanding of feature preparation, model training, backtesting, and inference workflows.
- **Data Quality and Observability: experience building validation frameworks, monitoring, alerting, and data lineage for production systems.
- **Engineering Ownership: a track record of owning data solutions from design and implementation through deployment and operations.

- Regelmäßige Mitarbeitergespräche, Feedbackrunden und die persönliche Betreuung unserer externen Kolleg:innen gehören ebenfalls zu deinem Verantwortungsbereich
- Du pflegst Bewerber- und Mitarbeiterdaten, verfolgst laufende Prozesse und unterstützt den Ausbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen

Deine Vorteile bei uns

- Rahmenbedingungen: unbefristete Festanstellung, 30 Urlaubstage, Urlaubsgeld, Einkaufsvergünstigungen, vermögenswirksame Leistungen und die Möglichkeit eines Company Bikes

Dein Profil

- Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein Studium und interessierst dich für Recruiting, Kundenmanagement und Mitarbeiterbetreuung
- Erste Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Recruiting, Vertriebsinnendienst, Account Management, Customer Success oder Personalwesen sind von Vorteil
- Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und schaffst es, langfristige Beziehungen aufzubauen und zu pflegen
- Organisationstalent, Kommunikationsstärke und ein serviceorientiertes Mindset zeichnen dich aus
- Du behältst auch bei mehreren Themen gleichzeitig den Überblick und arbeitest eigenständig sowie lösungsorientiert
- Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2)

title: Director - Client Service & Product Architecture (f/m/d)
description:
Director - Client Service & Product Architecture (f/m/d)

Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work:

We are seeking an experienced and client-focused Head of Client Service & Product Architecture to lead and scale our client-facing service organization for our next-generation fund-distribution market infrastructure, built on blockchain, cloud-native, and microservice technologies.
This role is responsible for defining the client-service strategy, ensuring operational excellence, and delivering an outstanding service experience for our institutional customers. As the voice of the client within the organization, this leader will influence Clients' experience, lead service reviews, oversee incident management, and ensure that every client receives timely, accurate, and proactive support.
The ideal candidate combines service leadership, operational discipline, and strong knowledge of financial industry workflows, with the ability to build trust with clients and internal teams alike.

Your responsibilities:

Client Service Strategy & Leadership

• Define and execute the end-to-end client service strategy, covering support, incident response, and ongoing day to day client interactions.
• Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing client service team supporting institutional clients across multiple regions.
• Establish client-centric KPIs, quality standards, and SLAs aligned with business objectives and regulatory expectations.
• Promote a strong client-success culture across the company.

Operational Support & Issue Resolution

• Lead the day-to-day operations of the Client Service function, ensuring timely response to client requests, tickets, and escalations.
• Oversee incident management, root-cause analysis, and communication for service disruptions or critical issues.
• Implement continuous improvement initiatives based on metrics, trends, and post-incident reviews.
• Ensure all support processes adhere to security, data protection, and operational risk standards.

Client Relationship & Communication

• Act as a senior point of escalation for key clients, building trust through transparency, accountability, and proactive engagement.
• Conduct regular service reviews with major clients to discuss performance, roadmap updates, and improvement opportunities.
• Provide clear communication on product changes, maintenance schedules, and operational impacts.

Collaboration & Cross-Functional Influence

• Work closely with Product Engineering, QA, Compliance, and Clearstream teams to relay client feedback and ensure alignment on support priorities.
• Influence product roadmap decisions by systematically capturing client needs, pain points, and usage patterns.
• Support regulatory and audit requirements relating to service quality, operational resilience, and client communications.

Tools, Processes & Governance

• Select and manage customer support tools, ticketing systems, dashboards, and monitoring solutions.
• Define standard operating procedures (SOPs), support guidelines, and escalation paths.
• Ensure accurate and up-to-date documentation for clients and internal teams (knowledge base, runbooks, FAQs).
• Support audit readiness and compliance checks related to client service operations.

Your profile:

• Leadership & Experience: 8–12+ years of experience in client service or customer success, including several years of experience building, scaling, and leading teams.
• Industry Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of fintech, financial services, or regulated environments, with preferred knowledge of Transfer Agency, fund distribution, or market infrastructure.
• Technical Aptitude: Familiarity with cloud-native platforms, APIs, microservices, and complex integration-driven products; exposure to blockchain/DLT is a strong asset.
• Institutional Client Management: Proven ability to manage institutional clients, build strong relationships, and successfully resolve complex technical escalations.
• Operational Excellence: A data-driven, problem-solving mindset with experience managing KPIs, SLAs, and incident-management processes in critical environments.
• Collaboration & Onboarding: Strong project-management skills to coordinate client onboarding and collaborate effectively with cross-functional product and engineering teams.
• Adaptability & Communication: Exceptional communication and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth, and regulated environment.

title: Team Lead Client Success Management (f/m/d)

Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work:

We are seeking an experienced Head of Client Success Management to lead our client-facing solution design and project delivery organization. You will be at the helm of our next-generation fund-distribution market infrastructure, built on blockchain, cloud-native, and microservice technologies.

This strategic leadership role is responsible for defining the end-to-end client implementation strategy, from initial solution architecture to successful onboarding and go-live. You will lead and mentor a high-performing team composed of Client Solution Managers—our Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) who design tailored client solutions—and Client Project Managers who execute and deliver these initiatives.

As the leader of this critical function, you will ensure that client requirements are expertly captured, translated into scalable solutions, and delivered flawlessly. The ideal candidate combines deep financial industry knowledge, strong leadership acumen, and a proven track-to-record in managing complex, technology-driven client projects in a regulated environment.

Your responsibilities:

title: Erzieher/in (m/w/d) im Krippenbereich Kunst-Kita (Sozialpädagogische/r Assistent/in / Kinderpfleger/in)
description:
Lorenzini Kunst-Kita – Kreativ von Anfang an!

Seit 2008 schaffen wir in Hamburg mit unseren mittlerweile fünf Kitas im Krippen- und Elementarbereich Räume, in denen Kinder selbstbestimmt lernen, ihrem Forscherdrang nachgehen und ihre Neugier stillen können. Unser Raum-in-Raum-Konzept bildet verschiedene Funktionsbereiche mit Spiel- und Arbeitsmaterialien, die allen Kindern klare Spielanreize bieten und deren Phantasie anregen. Wir orientieren uns an der Reggio-Pädagogik und integrieren ausgewählte Elemente der Montessori-Pädagogik. Bei uns steht die Kunst- und Kreativitätsförderung im Mittelpunkt, denn wir sind überzeugt, dass dies der Schlüssel zu einer erfolgreichen frühkindlichen Bildung und Betreuung ist.

Für den Krippenbereich unserer AVA in der Averhoffstraße in Hamburg-Uhlenhorst suchen wir ab sofort engagierte und kreative

Erzieher/innen (m/w/d) für den Krippenbereich

in Voll- oder Teilzeit (ab 30 Stunden/Woche)

Die Krippenräume in unserer AVA sind für 30 Kinder ausgelegt und befinden sich im Erdgeschoss, neben unserem Kinderrestaurant. Der Krippenbereich bietet den Kindern eine gemütliche Leseecke, eine Forscherecke und ein Atelier. Daran schließt sich die Bauecke und die Kinderwohnung an. Der Bewegungsraum fungiert gleichzeitig als Schlafraum. Außerdem gibt es einen Musikraum, in dem ein Klavier und viele weitere Musikinstrumente zu finden sind.

Als Erzieher bist du bei uns mehr als nur eine Betreuungsperson. Du begleitest die Kinder, wenn sie ihre Welt erforschen und entdecken, sich frei entfalten und sich auch einmal bei uns einkuscheln. Bei uns arbeitest du mit professioneller Nähe, anstatt dich hinter einer gut gemeinten Distanz zu verstecken.

Deine Qualifikation:

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als staatlich anerkannter Erzieher, sozialpädagogischer Assistent, Kinderpfleger, Heilerzieher oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
- Begeisterung für die Arbeit mit Kindern und Interesse an der Reggio-Pädagogik.
- Kreativität und Freude an der Umsetzung künstlerischer Projekte.
- Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Empathie im Umgang mit Kindern und Eltern.
- Offenheit für neue pädagogische Ansätze und Bereitschaft zur Weiterentwicklung.

Das bieten wir:

- Leistungsgerechte Vergütung: dein Gehalt richtet sich transparent nach Deiner Qualifikation und ist vergleichbar zum TVöD SuE. Zudem bekommst du einen Zuschuss zum Deutschland-Ticket.
- Viel Erholung: 30 Tage Urlaub plus fünf Tage Freistellung bedeuten für dich sieben Wochen Freizeit im Jahr.
- Planbare Arbeitszeiten: für Montag bis Freitag bekommst du rechtzeitig eine verlässliche Dienstplanung von uns, das Wochenende und die Feiertage gehören dir.
- Pädagogische Ausrichtung: unsere offene Arbeit, angelehnt an die Reggio-Pädagogik mit ausgewählten Elementen der Montessori-Pädagogik, lässt dich unsere pädagogische Haltung mit Respekt, Regeln und Wertschätzung auf Augenhöhe erleben
- Kreativer Arbeitsbereich: du bringst deine künstlerischen Fähigkeiten ein und hilfst den Kindern, ihre kreative Seite zu entdecken und zu entfalten.
- Wertschätzung der Raumgestaltung: du gestaltest und pflegst die Funktionsbereiche mit und sorgst so dafür, dass der Raum als dritter Erzieher eine anregende Lernumgebung bietet.
- Wertiges Spiel- und Arbeitsmaterial: du hast Zugang zu einer Vielzahl von Materialien und Techniken, um den Kindern ein breites Spektrum an kreativen Möglichkeiten zu bieten und vielfältige pädagogische Ansätze umzusetzen.
- Teamarbeit: wir teilen dieselbe Leidenschaft für Kunst und Pädagogik, tauschen uns in unserer wöchentlichen Teamzeit über Ideen für die Entwicklung unserer Arbeit aus und lernen durch regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche.
- Niedriger Erzieher-Kind-Schlüssel: unser offenes Raum-in-Raum-Konzept, in dem sich jeweils Krippen- und Elementarkinder die Räume teilen, ergibt einen besseren Erzieher-Kind-Schlüssel, so dass du dich intensiver um die Bedürfnisse der Kinder kümmern kannst.
- Persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung: vielfältige Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie jährlich stattfindende Studien- und Fachtage mit den Lorenzini-Kollegen aus den verschiedenen Einrichtungen sorgen für fachlichen Austausch und vermitteln neue pädagogische Ansätze. Berufseinsteigern bieten wir in den ersten Jahren eine enge Begleitung im Team.

Schau dir auch gerne unser Youtube-Video an, wenn du mehr über die Arbeit bei uns erfahren möchtest: youtu.be/Eib75FXd1xA

Du suchst eine Tätigkeit, in die du dich einerseits voll einbringen, dich aber auch auf feste und sichere Abläufe verlassen kannst? Du hast keine Lust mehr auf nur „satt, sicher, sauber“, sondern suchst eine Kita mit flachen Hierarchien, die Raum für eigene Ideen lässt, dir aber auch eine Struktur bietet, die auf vielen Jahren Erfahrung im frühkindlichen Bildungsbereich basiert?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung per Mail an Lorenz@kunst-kita.de

title: Ergotherapeut (m/w/d/kA) für Wohnpflegeheim für Menschen mit komplexer Behinderung in Würzburg (Heilpädagoge/-pädagogin)
description:
Unser Unternehmen

Die Arche gGmbH ist ein überregionaler und gleichzeitig dezentral organisierter Arbeitgeber mit über 850 Mitarbeitenden und ist Mitglied der Diakonie Bayern und Sachsen. Die Arche gGmbH bietet eine Vielzahl von Leistungen in den Bereichen Kinder- und Jugendhilfe, Behindertenhilfe, Berufshilfe und Seniorenhilfe in Bayern und Sachsen an.

Ihr Arbeitsplatz

Sie arbeiten in einem kleinen und familiären Wohnpflegeheim für 30 Menschen mit komplexer Beeinträchtigung.
Ein multiprofessionelles Team aus Heilerziehungspfleger:innen, Pflegefachkräften, Heilpädagog:innen und Ergotherapeut:innen (m/w/d/kA) wirkt zusammen, um die Bewohner:innen ganzheitlich zu fördern, zu betreuen und zu pflegen.

Regelmäßige Ausflüge, Feiern im Jahreskreis, besondere Veranstaltungen wie Hippotherapie, Bootstage und Flugtage sind neben individuellen Unternehmungen mit Bewohnern fester Bestandteil des Alltags.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Entwicklung und Verbesserung der sozioemotionalen Fähigkeiten, u.a. im Bereich der emotionalen Steuerung, der Affekte oder der Kommunikation
- Training von Alltagsaktivitäten gegebenenfalls mit geeigneten Hilfsmitteln im Hinblick auf die persönliche und die häusliche Selbständigkeit
- Integration in die Gruppengemeinschaft und Umwelt mit situationsgerechtem Verhalten und sozioemotionaler Kompetenz
- Versorgung der Menschen mit Behinderung mit Hilfsmitteln
- Realitätsbezogenheit, Förderung von Selbst- und Fremdwahrnehmung
- Psychische Stabilisierung vor allem in Bezug auf die Krankheitsverarbeitung

Das bringen Sie mit

- eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Ergothepareut:in (m/w/d/kA) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Gesprächs- und Konfliktlösungskompetenz
- hohe Belastbarkeit
- Lust und Interesse an einer langfristigen, systematischen Unterstützung den Menschen mit Behinderung
- Teamfähigkeit

Das bieten wir Ihnen

- leistungsgerechte Vergütung nach Tarif (AVR Bayern)
- betriebliche Altersvorsorge
- Jahressonderzahlungen (Weihnachtsgeld)
- flexible Arbeitszeiten
- Teilnahme an inner- und außerbetrieblichen Fortbildungen
- kompetentes, familiäres und motiviertes Team
- Benefits für Mitarbeiter:innen (Job-Bike, Nutzung der Einkaufsplattform der Kirchen WGKD u. a.)
- Arche-Zeit-Konto
- Familienbudget
- Unterstützung bei der Wohnungssuche
- 30 Tage Urlaub bei einer Fünf-Tage Woche

Das ist noch nicht alles – eine vollständige Liste aller Leistungen finden Sie auf der Seite Wir als Arbeitgeber (https://www.archeggmbh.de/mitarbeiten-in-der-arche/wir-als-arbeitgeber) .

title: Sachbearbeitung (m/w/d) Bauverwaltung und Bauordnung (Verwaltungsfachangestellte/r - Kommunalverwaltung)
description:
Öffentliche Stellenausschreibung

Die Gemeinde Halstenbek mit ca. 18.500 Einwohner*innen (m/w/d) und mit dem Naherholungsgebiet Krupunder See liegt in landschaftlich reizvoller Lage am Stadtrand von Hamburg. Autobahn und S-Bahn bieten optimale Verkehrsanbindungen in die Hamburger Innenstadt. Alle allgemeinbildenden Schulen mit entsprechenden Sportstätten sowie mehrere Kindertagesstätten unter eigener und fremder Trägerschaft befinden sich am Ort. Zwei Büchereien und ein Jugendzentrum runden das Angebot ab.

Im Fachdienst Ortsplanung & Bauverwaltung suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt, in unbefristeter Anstellung:

Sachbearbeitung (m/w/d) Bauverwaltung und Bauordnung

mit Schwerpunkt Bauordnungsrecht, kommunale Bauleitplanung und Beitragswesen

in Vollzeit

**Wir bieten Ihnen: **

- Ein Entgelt nach der Entgeltgruppe** 9b**des Tarifvertrags für den öffentlichen Dienst (TVöD)
(tarifliches Jahresvollzeitgehalt von ca. 48.570Euro brutto bis 68.276 Euro brutto je nach Berufserfahrung und Personalgewinnungsaspekt)
- Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle (Rahmenarbeitszeit von 06:00 Uhr bis 20:00 Uhr) und attraktive Lösungen, wie mobiles Arbeiten (bis zu 50%), zur Unterstützung der Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf
- Sonderleistungen des öffentlichen Dienstes: Jahressonderzahlung im Juli und November, betriebliche Altersvorsorge (VBL)
- Eine gute Erreichbarkeit mit Mobilitätszulage von 30,- € im Rahmen eines Jobtickets Premium
- 30 Tage Urlaub/Jahr bei einer 5-Tage-Woche+ 2 zusätzliche freie Tage an Heiligabend und Silvester
- Vollumfänglicher Freizeitausgleich für Mehrarbeit
- Individuelle Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

title: Director - Client Service & Product Architecture (f/m/d)
description:
Director - Client Service & Product Architecture (f/m/d)

Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work:

We are seeking an experienced and client-focused Head of Client Service & Product Architecture to lead and scale our client-facing service organization for our next-generation fund-distribution market infrastructure, built on blockchain, cloud-native, and microservice technologies.
This role is responsible for defining the client-service strategy, ensuring operational excellence, and delivering an outstanding service experience for our institutional customers. As the voice of the client within the organization, this leader will influence Clients' experience, lead service reviews, oversee incident management, and ensure that every client receives timely, accurate, and proactive support.
The ideal candidate combines service leadership, operational discipline, and strong knowledge of financial industry workflows, with the ability to build trust with clients and internal teams alike.

Your responsibilities:

Client Service Strategy & Leadership

• Define and execute the end-to-end client service strategy, covering support, incident response, and ongoing day to day client interactions.
• Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing client service team supporting institutional clients across multiple regions.
• Establish client-centric KPIs, quality standards, and SLAs aligned with business objectives and regulatory expectations.
• Promote a strong client-success culture across the company.

Operational Support & Issue Resolution

• Lead the day-to-day operations of the Client Service function, ensuring timely response to client requests, tickets, and escalations.
• Oversee incident management, root-cause analysis, and communication for service disruptions or critical issues.
• Implement continuous improvement initiatives based on metrics, trends, and post-incident reviews.
• Ensure all support processes adhere to security, data protection, and operational risk standards.

Client Relationship & Communication

• Act as a senior point of escalation for key clients, building trust through transparency, accountability, and proactive engagement.
• Conduct regular service reviews with major clients to discuss performance, roadmap updates, and improvement opportunities.
• Provide clear communication on product changes, maintenance schedules, and operational impacts.

Collaboration & Cross-Functional Influence

• Work closely with Product Engineering, QA, Compliance, and Clearstream teams to relay client feedback and ensure alignment on support priorities.
• Influence product roadmap decisions by systematically capturing client needs, pain points, and usage patterns.
• Support regulatory and audit requirements relating to service quality, operational resilience, and client communications.

Tools, Processes & Governance

• Select and manage customer support tools, ticketing systems, dashboards, and monitoring solutions.
• Define standard operating procedures (SOPs), support guidelines, and escalation paths.
• Ensure accurate and up-to-date documentation for clients and internal teams (knowledge base, runbooks, FAQs).
• Support audit readiness and compliance checks related to client service operations.

Your profile:

• Leadership & Experience: 8–12+ years of experience in client service or customer success, including several years of experience building, scaling, and leading teams.
• Industry Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of fintech, financial services, or regulated environments, with preferred knowledge of Transfer Agency, fund distribution, or market infrastructure.
• Technical Aptitude: Familiarity with cloud-native platforms, APIs, microservices, and complex integration-driven products; exposure to blockchain/DLT is a strong asset.
• Institutional Client Management: Proven ability to manage institutional clients, build strong relationships, and successfully resolve complex technical escalations.
• Operational Excellence: A data-driven, problem-solving mindset with experience managing KPIs, SLAs, and incident-management processes in critical environments.
• Collaboration & Onboarding: Strong project-management skills to coordinate client onboarding and collaborate effectively with cross-functional product and engineering teams.
• Adaptability & Communication: Exceptional communication and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth, and regulated environment.

title: Team Lead Client Success Management (f/m/d)
description:
Team Lead Client Success Management (f/m/d)

Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work:

We are seeking an experienced Head of Client Success Management to lead our client-facing solution design and project delivery organization. You will be at the helm of our next-generation fund-distribution market infrastructure, built on blockchain, cloud-native, and microservice technologies.

This strategic leadership role is responsible for defining the end-to-end client implementation strategy, from initial solution architecture to successful onboarding and go-live. You will lead and mentor a high-performing team composed of Client Solution Managers—our Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) who design tailored client solutions—and Client Project Managers who execute and deliver these initiatives.

As the leader of this critical function, you will ensure that client requirements are expertly captured, translated into scalable solutions, and delivered flawlessly. The ideal candidate combines deep financial industry knowledge, strong leadership acumen, and a proven track-to-record in managing complex, technology-driven client projects in a regulated environment.

Your responsibilities:

Strategy & Leadership

• Define and execute the comprehensive strategy for client solution design, project management, and onboarding, ensuring alignment with business objectives and product roadmaps.
• Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing organization of Client Solution Managers (SMEs) and Client Project Managers, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and client-centricity.
• Establish and govern the KPIs, quality standards, and methodologies for the entire client implementation lifecycle, from scoping and SoW creation to project delivery and handover to Client Service.
• Act as the senior-most point of contact for strategic client escalations related to solution design and project delivery, building trust through transparency and effective leadership.

Solution Design & Governance

• Oversee the Client Solution Management function, reinforcing their role as Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in translating complex client needs into robust, scalable target operating models.
• Govern the solution design process, ensuring that all client proposals and Statements of Work (SoWs) are aligned with platform capabilities, product strategy, and delivery capacity.
• Empower Client Solution Managers (SMEs) to advise clients on best practices for adopting our platform, ensuring long-term value and client success.

Project & Onboarding Delivery Oversight

• Lead the Client Project Management function, ensuring the consistent and successful delivery of all client onboarding and implementation projects.
• Standardize and optimize the project management framework, including planning, risk management (RAID), resource allocation, and reporting, to ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Ensure seamless coordination across internal teams (Product, Engineering, QA, Client Service) to align all delivery activities with client expectations.

Cross-Functional Influence & Collaboration

• Partner closely with the Heads of Product Engineering, and Client Service to ensure a cohesive, end-to-end client journey.
• Influence the product roadmap by systematically consolidating and relaying client requirements, strategic opportunities, and feedback gathered during the solutioning and delivery process.
• Collaborate with Sales and Business Development to provide expert guidance during RFPs, pre-sales discussions, and commercial scoping.

Your profile:

• Leadership & Experience: 10–15+ years in client-facing roles (implementation, consulting, or services) with 5+ years of experience leading, motivating, and scaling technical teams.
• Domain Expertise: Deep background in FinTech, capital markets, fund distribution, transfer agency, or highly regulated financial-workflow environments.
• Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with API-driven integrations, data migration, cloud-native platforms, and microservices.
• Portfolio & Project Management: Proven history of managing portfolios of complex, concurrent projects for institutional clients, utilizing Agile delivery methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence).
• Dual Design & Delivery Focus: Demonstrated capability to oversee both technical solution architecture and end-to-end project management.
• Strategic & Data-Driven Mindset: Ability to translate high-level business goals into delivery plans, using data to drive operational efficiency and quality assurance.
• Executive Stakeholder Collaboration: Exceptional communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills, with a track record of partnering with cross-functional executives (Product, Engineering, Sales, Compliance).

title: Talent Acquisition Partner (f/m/d) (Talent-Acquisition-Manager/in)
employer: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As a Talent Acquisition Partner (f/m/d), you will support recruiting activities for Gas Services while partnering closely with business leaders, HR Business Partners, and a global Talent Acquisition network. Beyond leading day-to-day recruiting operations, you will drive recruiting projects, mentor recruiters, and continuously improve recruiting efficiency and delivery. This role offers a long-term career path with the opportunity to grow into a broader Talent Acquisition leadership position within Gas Services as organizational responsibilities evolve.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Strategic partnership with business leaders and hiring managers across a complex global matrix organization to develop and execute recruiting strategies aligned with business priorities
* Operational leadership and coaching of project teams, ensuring effective workload allocation, capacity planning, prioritization, and delivery against KPIs and service level expectations
* Leadership of Talent Acquisition projects and support of organizational transformation and continuous improvement initiatives across the global Talent Acquisition organization
* Analysis of recruiting metrics and market insights to identify optimization opportunities and drive data-informed decisions that enhance recruiting effectiveness and process excellence
* End-to-end management of recruiting activities across a broad range of functions and position levels, including both tariff and non-tariff roles, while ensuring an outstanding candidate and hiring manager experience
* Close collaboration with HR, Works Councils, business leaders, and global stakeholders to provide guidance on recruiting processes, governance, labor relations, and talent acquisition strategies

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field
* Extensive Talent Acquisition experience with a strong end-to-end recruiting generalist background, ideally gained within a global industrial or corporate environment
* Proven experience leading recruiting projects and successfully navigating complex matrix organizations with multiple stakeholder groups
* Strong project management skills and experience driving recruiting or organizational transformation initiatives.
* High data affinity with the ability to interpret recruiting metrics, generate insights, and make data-driven decisions using applicant tracking systems and recruiting analytics
* Sound understanding of collective bargaining agreements (tariff structures), experience collaborating with Works Councils, and familiarity with governance processes in a corporate environment
* Professional proficiency in German and English

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

employer: Hotel Deimann GmbH & Co. KG Hotel Deimann
description:
Es ist noch früh am Nachmittag, als in der Küche des Hotel Störmann die ersten Töpfe auf den Herd kommen. Ein Blick auf den Tagesplan, ein kurzer Austausch über die Abendkarte, dann beginnt die Vorbereitung – ruhig, konzentriert, mit der Erfahrung vieler Service-Abende im Rücken. Mitten in der historischen Altstadt von Schmallenberg, in einem Haus, das seit Generationen für herzliche Gastfreundschaft steht und seit einigen Jahren zur Familie Deimann gehört, treffen Tradition und moderne Hotelküche aufeinander. Hier kennt man sich, hier verlässt man sich aufeinander, und hier hat Ihr Posten seinen festen Platz im Ablauf des Abends. Als Chef de Partie übernehmen Sie Verantwortung für Ihren Bereich der Küche – mit dem Rückhalt eines eingespielten Teams und der Gelassenheit eines Hauses, das weiß, was es kann.

Aufgaben

- Sie sorgen dafür, dass auf Ihrem Posten alles vorbereitet ist, bevor der erste Teller den Pass verlässt.
- Sie bringen Ihre Erfahrung und Ihr handwerkliches Können dort ein, wo aus guten Zutaten verlässlich gute Gerichte entstehen.
- Sie behalten auch dann den Überblick, wenn mehrere Bestellungen gleichzeitig auf Ihren Posten kommen.
- Sie achten auf Sauberkeit, Qualität und die Einhaltung der Hygienestandards, ohne dass es jemand extra ansprechen muss.
- Sie stimmen sich mit den Kolleginnen und Kollegen an den anderen Posten ab, damit jeder Teller zur richtigen Zeit den Pass erreicht.
- Sie unterstützen bei der Warenannahme und -kontrolle und wissen, worauf es bei guten Produkten ankommt.
- Sie bringen eigene Ideen zu Gerichten und Abläufen ein, wenn sich die Gelegenheit dazu bietet.
- Sie zeigen jüngeren Kolleginnen und Kollegen sowie Auszubildenden gerne, wie man ein Handwerk richtig lernt.

Qualifikation

- Sie haben Ihre Ausbildung als Koch oder Köchin erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
- Sie bringen bereits Berufserfahrung in der Küche eines Hotels oder Restaurants mit.
- Sie beherrschen Ihr Handwerk sicher und arbeiten auch unter Druck sauber und strukturiert.
- Sie übernehmen gerne eigenverantwortlich einen Posten und behalten dabei den Überblick.
- Sie legen Wert auf gute Produkte und eine saubere, durchdachte Zubereitung.
- Sie arbeiten gerne im Team und unterstützen sich gegenseitig, wenn es im Service eng wird.
- Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für Ihren Bereich, ohne dass man Ihnen hinterherlaufen muss.

Mitten in Dortmund erwartet unsere Gäste ein familiengeführtes 4-Sterne-Hotel mit persönlicher Atmosphäre, regionaler Küche und einem starken Teamgeist.

Ob im Restaurant „Neunzehn30“ oder in unserer Pilsstube „Alte Gasse“ – bei uns steht echter Service und ein herzliches Miteinander im Mittelpunkt.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort:

Servicemitarbeiter (m/w/d) für unser Restaurant „NEUNZEHN30“

Du hast Freude am Umgang mit Menschen, arbeitest gerne im Team und möchtest unseren Gästen eine gute Zeit bereiten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

** Werde Teil eines Hauses, in dem Gäste zu Freunden werden – und Mitarbeitende geschätzt werden.**

Worauf Sie sich freuen können

- eine leistungsgerechte Vergütung inklusive Sonn- und Feiertagszuschlägen
- zusätzliches Trinkgeld durch eine faire und transparente Trinkgeldregelung
- pünktliche und zuverlässige Gehaltszahlungen
- frühzeitige Dienstplanung für eine bessere Planung Ihrer Freizeit
- klare, zusammenhängende Arbeitszeiten ohne Teildienst
- Mitarbeiterrabatte innerhalb des Hauses
- eine gute Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr
- ein angenehmes Arbeitsklima in einem familiären und motivierten Team
- einen modern ausgestatteten Arbeitsplatz
- eine strukturierte Einarbeitung
- Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
- einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz in einem etablierten, familiengeführten 4-Sterne-Hotel

Ihre Aufgaben bei uns

Als Servicemitarbeiter sind Sie nah am Gast und tragen wesentlich dazu bei, dass sich unsere Gäste willkommen, gut beraten und rundum betreut fühlen.

Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören:

- Sie empfangen unsere Gäste freundlich und sorgen von Beginn an für eine angenehme Atmosphäre
- Sie nehmen Bestellungen auf und beraten zu Speisen, Getränken sowie aktuellen Empfehlungen
- Sie servieren Speisen und Getränke aufmerksam, fachgerecht und mit Blick fürs Detail
- Sie sorgen gemeinsam mit Küche und Bar für einen reibungslosen Ablauf im Service
- Sie bereiten den Gastraum vor und halten den Servicebereich gepflegt und einladend
- Sie übernehmen Kassiertätigkeiten und arbeiten sicher mit gängigen Kassensystemen
- Sie gehen professionell und lösungsorientiert mit Gästewünschen und Reklamationen um
- Sie achten auf Sauberkeit und halten die geltenden Hygienevorschriften ein
- Sie unterstützen die allgemeinen Abläufe im Servicebereich und bringen sich aktiv ins Team ein

Was Sie mitbringen

Für uns zählt nicht nur der Lebenslauf, sondern vor allem Ihre Freude am Service und Ihr Gespür für Gäste.

Wir freuen uns, wenn Sie:

- idealerweise eine Ausbildung in der Gastronomie oder Hotellerie abgeschlossen haben oder bereits Erfahrung im Service mitbringen
- freundlich, gepflegt und serviceorientiert auftreten
- gerne im Team arbeiten und zuverlässig sind
- auch in stressigen Situationen ruhig und organisiert bleiben
- flexibel einsetzbar sind und Bereitschaft zu Schicht-, Wochenend- und Feiertagsdiensten mitbringen
- über gute Deutschkenntnisse verfügen; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil
- idealerweise bereits Erfahrung im Umgang mit Kassensystemen haben
- ein gutes Bewusstsein für Hygiene, Sauberkeit und Ordnung mitbringen

title: Research Associate (PhD Student) (m/f/d) in Computational Biology / Bioinformatics (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
description:
...you're in the middle of it

Our **Department of Nephrology **and the Else Kroener-Fresenius-Center (EKFZ) provide excellent, state-of-the-art facilities to conduct interdisciplinary and computational research at the intersection of nephrology, immunology, and cardiovascular biology. We offer an attractive, supportive environment for modern science in molecular medicine and systems biology. We are looking for an ambitious, talented and highly motivated candidate to join our team.

The project that you are working on is embedded in a translational research program aiming to understand how the hematopoietic system crosslinks interactions between aging, cardiovascular, and kidney diseases. You will integrate multi-omic datasets to investigate molecular and cellular mechanisms in various organs and immune cells. By bridging single-cell resolution with global biobank scales, your work will help identify novel molecular mechanisms and therapeutic targets.

The candidate will be supervised and supported by experienced computational biologists, molecular biologists and clinicians. The project is designed to perform cutting-edge research with state-of-the-art methods and technologies.

Your Role:

- Analyze and integrate in-house and publicly available single-cell RNA-seq, single-cell ATAC-seq, and CITE-seq datasets
- Analyze large-scale genomic, proteomic and clinical data from the UK Biobank (UKB) and All of Us Research Program
- Develop and implement reproducible and scalable computational pipelines and workflows
- Collaborate closely with experimental biologists and clinicians in an interdisciplinary environment to define hypotheses and interpret results in a biological and clinical context
- Present research findings within the working group and at international conferences and publish in peer-reviewed journals and cumulate your findings in a doctoral thesis

... your skills are what we're looking for

- Master’s degree (or equivalent) in computational or molecular biology, bioinformatics, molecular medicine or a related field
- Proficiency in either R or Python for data analysis, statistics, and visualization.
- Previous experience with bioinformatic analysis of single-cell RNAseq analysis (Seurat/Scanpy) and/or genetic data
- A solid foundational understanding of molecular biology, genetics, or immunology, and a keen interest in human disease mechanisms.
- Keen interest in leveraging omics to elucidate disease mechanisms in cardiovascular and/or kidney disease and immunology
- Previous experience with reproducible coding practices and working in cloud environments is a plus.
- Solid understanding of statistics
- Willingness to understand and apply state-of-the-art computational tools and algorithms for single-cell, multi-omics and genetic analysis
- Very good verbal and written skills in English; German is an advantage but not required
- High motivation, ability to work independently as well as in an interdisciplinary team, excellent organizational and communication skills
- Due to legal regulations, valid proof of measles immunity / measles vaccination is required.

... you'll be offered a lot

- In addition to an attractive salary based on acollective agreement with an annual special payment, you benefit from long-term security through company pension schemes
- Internal and external training for your professional development
- Benefit from our attractive health offers. We offer regular online and face-to-face courses on nutrition, relaxation, sports and exercise
- We offer childcare in our daycare center (if you have any questions, please contact UKF-Familienservice), child care during holidays
- Free public transport in all Hessen (Free State Ticket Hessen)
- Uniklinik-Campus, Mensa, Cafés
- Insights: Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn
- FAQ´s for new employees

**It's time to join our team! **

Kontakt: Dr. Simone-Franziska Glaser, Head of Research of the Else Kroener-Fresenius-Center
Mail: glaser@med.uni-frankfurt.de** **
Bewerbungsfrist: 06.09.2026

We welcome applications from candidates of all genders. Women are currently underrepresented in these positions at Universitätsmedizin Frankfurt. Therefore, applications from women are especially encouraged. Applicants with severe disabilities will be given preferential consideration in cases of equal personal and professional qualifications.

title: CFD Software Developer (Softwareentwickler/in)
description:
CFD Software Engineer (f/m/d)
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the
world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative
global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a
large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together
while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages
creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our
business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
Position Overview
Are you a passionate Software Engineer who enjoys working at
the intersection of numerical methods, high-performance computing, and
real-world engineering applications? We are searching for a talented CFD
Software Engineer to join our solver development team for Simcenter Ultrafluid (formerly Altair ultraFluidX, https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/) ), a small, dynamic, and agile team delivering world-class CFD software to
industries including automotive, heavy industry, and consumer electronics.
Simcenter Ultrafluid features a native GPU-based
implementation of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), allowing users to run
fully transient, high-fidelity aerodynamics and aeroacoustics simulations
overnight on a single compute server. The solver is designed to handle complex
geometries and demanding industrial use cases, delivering high-fidelity,
predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.
If you are seeking a role where you can contribute directly
to solver development, algorithm implementation, and GPU acceleration, while
translating cutting-edge academic research in numerical methods into a
high-performance, easy-to-use software product, and collaborating closely with
the whole development team on the advancement of the code and its capabilities,
then we'd love to hear from you!
Responsibilities

- Contribute
to the code development of Simcenter Ultrafluid as part of the agile
development team
- Specify,
implement, test, and document new high-quality features of the solver in
close collaboration with the other team members
- Contribute
to performance benchmarking and code optimization in a massively parallel
GPU environment, while collaborating with other development teams across
HPC, pre/post-processing, and meshing to integrate Simcenter Ultrafluid
into the broader Simcenter ecosystem
- Collaborate
with product management, application specialists, and QA engineers to
ensure the solver meets real-world industrial needs
- Participate
in daily stand-ups as well as regular review, retrospective, and planning
meetings

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

- M.Sc.
or Ph.D. degree in mechanical engineering, computational mechanics,
computer science, or a comparable physics-based discipline
- At
least two years of hands-on experience in CFD solver development in a
commercial or academic environment
- High
proficiency in C++ and parallel programming
- Excellent
English communication skills
- Passion
for numerical simulation and a drive to find creative solutions for
challenging industrial use cases with a focus on customer value
- Willingness
to work in a close-knit, agile development team

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience
with scripting or scientific programming languages such as Python or Julia
- Solid
understanding of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and its application in
CFD
- Solid
understanding of GPU architectures and experience with the CUDA toolkit

Why us?
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by
default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than
200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through
real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale
and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and
inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring you curiosity
and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites

- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement

- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.
. Escalating requests that cannot be resolved to other team members, and team leaders located both in the UK and Germany.
. Delivering service excellence by efficiently problem-solving and reacting in a professional, polite and clear manner.
. Accurately logging all Dealer contacts and following up on cases using Opel/Vauxhall database systems.
. Attending team and other meetings for review of issues, assignments, regular discussion.

What we're looking for:
. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

Budaörs is a small city of around 30,000 people, situated at the southern edge of the Buda Hills less than 10km from Budapest. The city offers contemporary architecture, the picturesque old town, breath-taking natural surroundings and historic monuments. You can reach Budapest in a matter of minutes via road or public transport.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!
